jobs.title: Senior Associate, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Corporate Strategy

Job Description

Strategy Group summary:
Founded by former strategy consultants, Capital One is a strategy driven company. The Corporate Strategy group engages on a number of ultra-high impact issues that drive the direction and performance of the company. Projects focus primarily on formulating enduring and profitable growth and value enhancement strategies, while working within the business to ensure follow through.
The Corporate Research team (within Corporate Strategy) serves as Capital One’s competitive intelligence team, leveraging data, research, and financial analysis to provide company leadership with competitive and market intelligence, insights and advice, and strategic communications.

Position summary:
As an analyst on the Corporate Research team, you will collaborate with C-suite executives, Strategy, Investor Relations, Finance, and various other teams across the company to provide research support, market insight, and company-wide communication. You will work on a variety of different initiatives in a close team environment. Many of the day-to-day projects emphasize a need for strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Key to success in the role will be synthesizing information from various sources, performing analysis, and integrating findings into cohesive and insightful presentations and summaries.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Provide analytical support to senior management across the company

- Provide recurring and ad hoc research to support various business lines and internal partners

- Benchmark Capital One’s performance vs. industry competitors

- Daily monitoring of financial and economic events to inform senior leadership how they impact Capital One

- Analysis of large financial data sets (Fed, FDIC, Census, etc.)

- ‘Deep dives’ and longer-term projects on a wide range of topics relevant to Capital One

- Ad hoc project work with partner teams (Strategy, Corporate Development)

- Analyze and benchmark Capital One and competitor capital and balance sheet performance (including CCAR, DFAST, funding profile, regulatory disclosures, etc.)

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree

- At least 2 years of consulting or investment banking experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of analytical rigor and attention to detail

- Interest or experience with the banking or payments industries

- Financial modeling or investment research expertise

- Strong judgment and problem-solving skills

- Team player with a positive attitude

- Naturally inquisitive with a passion to “figure stuff out”

- Confidence and intent to drive change

jobs.title: Principal Associate - Program Manager- Product College
jobs.description:
Principal Associate - Program Manager- Product College

Imagine being a part of an enterprise wide initiative that is at the forefront of how we approach product management across Capital One. The Product College team is focused on designing and executing learning experiences that support our product management competencies and play an integral role in how we grow our product talent and reputation in the market. Our team is collaborative, creative and passionate about helping our associates grow in their careers.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team as Program Managers, with an opportunity to lead either our Product Onboarding or our Product Manager Machine Learning programs. As a member of the Product College team, the Principal Associate will be responsible for partnering closely with key business partners in Capital One’s Product organizations to deliver practical and immersive learning experiences. This role will coordinate the delivery of self-paced and cohort programmatic experiences, both in-person and virtually, to meet Product associates where they are and get them where they need to be—whether that is navigating their first 90 days at Capital One or upskilling in cutting-edge machine learning strategies. This role will partner closely with the leaders, instructional designers, Product associates, and other stakeholders to deliver a best-in-class program

The ideal candidate for this position:
- Has excellent project management skills; autonomously drives projects, logistics and strategy forward using sound judgment and critical thinking.
- Has experience delivering dynamic immersive learning experiences, with a particular focus on cohort learning and program execution.
- Dynamically adapts their communication style across verbal and written channels (e.g., Slack, email) to keep participants, facilitators, and executives engaged and apprised of important details.
- Has a consultative skill set and builds trust-based relationships to partner effectively with a wide range of clients, senior leaders and subject matter experts (including AI/ML technical leaders).
- Is highly data-driven and detail-oriented, with a keen ability to organize, synthesize, and analyze data to measure impact and drive continuous program improvement.

Key Responsibilities
- End-to-end program ownership: Own the day-to-day execution, annual strategy, and iteration of their program within Product College. Ensure a high-quality, associate-centric experience across the learner journey.
- Stakeholder & speaker management: Identify, brief, and seamlessly integrate executive product speakers, SMEs, and facilitators into the curriculum to ensure high-impact delivery. Maintain strong relationships with the Accountable Executive and key stakeholders to achieve the program's vision and adjust course based on internal and industry shifts.
- Data-driven continuous improvement: Analyze pre and post-session surveys and conduct comprehensive retrospective meetings after each cohort to identify themes and measure impact. Coordinate with necessary partners, including data teams, consultants, and instructional designers, to implement systemic, data-backed curriculum enhancements.
- Operations & budget integrity: Manage program budgets, external vendor relationships, track learner data and distribution lists, and coordinate the complex virtual and in-person logistics required to scale the program smoothly across multiple locations.
- Live session production: Act as a host and producer for learners during live learning sessions, managing immediate logistics such as facilitator preparedness, Zoom recordings, attendance tracking, and materials archiving.
- Program advocacy & communication: Manage all ongoing program communications (formal and informal) via Slack and email. Drive awareness and marketing efforts for the program within the broader Capital One product community and across other internal onboarding teams.
- Process excellence: Work on individual and team initiatives to design, build, and implement new scalable processes that ensure efficient, reliable, and resilient program delivery.

We recognize that many life paths can contribute to interest in this role. We value all experience, whether gained in a classroom or through other paths, and invite everyone who meets the below requirements to apply for this role.

Basic Qualifications
- High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent certification
- At least 2 years of experience in learning and development
- At least 1 year of experience in Program or Project Management, or a combination
- At least 1 year of consulting experience

Preferred Qualifications
- 3+ years of experience in learning and development
- 2+ years of experience in Program or Project Management
- 2+ years of consulting experience
- Process or Project Management Certification

jobs.title: Treasury Management Consultant III, Specialized Industries
jobs.description:
Treasury Management Consultant III, Specialized Industries

This role is centered on generating new and expanding existing full-service treasury management relationships for Sponsor and Specialized Industries clients. The Treasury Management Consultant (TMC) will be responsible for directly and/or indirectly selling and maintaining depository accounts and the treasury management services applied to those accounts for both new and existing Capital One relationships.

The Treasury Management Consultant will partner with internal stakeholders to be a single point of accountability or provide advice on the deposit, treasury management, risk, and other company liquidity needs of prospects and clients. Together, they will build a book of business through deposit growth, maintaining and cross-selling to existing clients, and prospecting for new-to-bank relationships.

The Treasury Management Consultant will focus on specific verticals within the Specialty Organization. Familiarity with these business verticals and the specific banking and financial operations of Technology, Media, Telecom (TMT) or Financial Institutions Group (FIG) clients is desirable. This TMC will also concentrate on working with dedicated TMT or FIG  Relationship Managers and leadership to generate new-to-bank relationships, while developing existing clients by delivering value-added solutions and collaborating across the product and technology organizations to optimize products for evolving client needs, with a focus on bringing in new deposits.

The Treasury Management Sales team works to identify ways to improve the client experience and enhance Capital One's brand in the marketplace. Seen as a trusted advisor, the TMC will work closely with commercial clients to understand their business, optimize treasury flow, and minimize financial and reputational risk. They will focus on creating and delivering customized, client-centric solutions through a consultative approach. Leveraging their network and collaborating across business lines, the TMC will influence strategy to meet the needs of clients while using sound judgment in assessing risk. The TMC will foster a spirit of teamwork and cooperation across value streams. This position works independently and uses initiative in carrying out assignments, requiring minimal guidance from the sales leader.

Responsibilities:
- Identifies both internal and external prospects. Develops and maintains relationships with prospects to profitably expand business

- Provides thought leadership within and outside the market through, but not limited to, hosting corporate events, attending and speaking at industry conferences, etc.

- Engages with internal marketing in the design of sales collateral and company-sponsored marketing

- Manages portfolio of existing clients with focus on profitable, organic revenue growth and minimizing attrition

- Manages portfolio of new-to-bank clients with focus on revenue growth

- Develops and maintains relationships with clients to maintain and expand existing business

- Knows business’s, organization, expected activity; identifies and communicates operational credit exposures and other risks

- Understands treasury management product risk and ensures Capital One credit policies and other risks (e.g., reputational, legal) are adhered to and mitigated

- Establishes appropriate expectations for onboarding including execution of documentation and ensure ramp of sold services

- Conducts independent and codependent sales calls on companies to generate new, high-quality and profitable Treasury Management and deposit business to achieve or exceed specific YoY growth goals

- Takes a role in market by actively engaging in local industry associations, networking groups and/or community associations

- Identifies working capital efficiency opportunities for a business and deepens relationship accordingly; ensures business awareness of market and industry trends; identifies dissatisfiers and escalates appropriately

- Identifies and refers ancillary business opportunities to appropriate partners

- Designs customer-centric treasury management solutions, and provides consultative expertise on the liquidity management cycle

Basic Qualifications:
- High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification

- At least 6 years of financial services experience

- At least 5 years of sales experience

- At least 5 years of treasury management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

- At least 7 years of treasury management experience

- In-depth to advanced treasury management product knowledge

- Effective oral and written communication skills

- Certified Treasury Professional designation or equivalent certification

jobs.title: Principal Associate, Chief of Staff - Global Payments Network
jobs.description:
Principal Associate, Chief of Staff - Global Payments Network

Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. Our mission is to create one of the nation’s great banks, and we have the necessary ingredients: a strong balance sheet, resilient businesses, a massive customer franchise, strong analytical capabilities, and great people. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared Values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.

As a Principal Associate Project Manager on the Integration program team, you will drive operational excellence by delivering impactful solutions for associates and customers while supporting strategic cross-functional projects that deliver direct organizational value. This role involves navigating ambiguity by taking high-level, complex questions and independently structuring actionable plans to solve them.

You will act as a key thought partner to team leadership and stakeholders, leveraging data-backed decisioning to influence outcomes, manage competing priorities, and enable efficient team operations. We are seeking an adaptable, analytical project leader capable of turning abstract problems into structured execution while building strong cross-functional alignment. Excellent communication skills are essential.

General Responsibilities:
- Operational Excellence & Associate/Customer Solutions: Manage key operational workflows and leadership forums to ensure seamless execution. Build well-managed, sustainable, and scalable solutions that address friction points for associates and drive better outcomes for customers.

- Strategic Problem Solving & Project Delivery: Structure ambiguous "white space" problems by taking high-level questions and independently executing plans to answer them. Drive work forward autonomously, establishing and socializing timelines and workback schedules to set clear expectations with stakeholders. Push thinking beyond initial problems toward second-order insights to create repeatable solutions that solve future issues.

- Executive Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling, data-driven presentations for senior audiences (with guidance from your manager). Bring structure to complex work so that it is repeatable and easily communicated. Articulate the business value of deliverables clearly to team members, key stakeholders, and partners.

- Thought Partnership & Influence: Act as a sounding board for your manager and step in for your manager in strategic conversations when necessary. Pull together data to support cohesive narratives, and push back on decision-making with logic, evidence, and data insights when appropriate. Show up as a consultant to others within your area of expertise.

- Stakeholder Management & Customer Focus: Build relationships and effectively collaborate with key partners to understand customer needs. Maintain a responsive service mindset, iterating with partners to guide them to the right solution while consistently setting and managing expectations.

- Teamwork & Culture: Routinely collaborate with a network of peers to share best practices, train teammates, and build community. Jump in to support others outside your immediate scope when bandwidth allows, providing leverage to the broader team.

The Ideal Candidate Will:
- Structure White Space: Demonstrate a proven ability to deal well with ambiguity—stepping into white space, making sense of it, and structuring repeatable plans to drive results.

- Exercise Grounded Judgment: Demonstrate data-backed decision-making, identifying and focusing on the highest-priority work while validating priorities with leadership when necessary.

- Drive Well-Managed Execution: Be detail- and action-oriented, operating with a sense of urgency, building sustainable processes, and leveraging a strong network to get work done.

- Communicate & Influence with Data: Exhibit strong written and verbal communication skills, framing complex work clearly, presenting business value, and influencing stakeholders through logic and data insights.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

- At least 3 Years Project Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Masters or MBA degree

- At least 5 years of Project Management experience

- PMP, Lean, Agile or Six Sigma certification

- Strong communication and collaboration skills

- Strong problem solving and influencing skills

jobs.title: Manager - Strategic Learning Business Consultant
jobs.description:
Manager - Strategic Learning Business Consultant

Capital One's Enterprise Learning & Development team is looking for a Strategic Business Consultant to shape and deliver the learning and development strategy to support our Enterprise Services, Software, Business Cards & Payments and enterprise Tech teams. You'll partner with key business and Human Resources (HR) leaders to design and implement learning initiatives for hundreds of associates spanning multiple job families within these lines of businesses.

We're seeking someone who can seamlessly connect business objectives with learning solutions, translating strategic ideas into impactful, learner-centered experiences. Whether your background is in strategy, business, program/product management, or learning strategy, your ability to build relationships with stakeholders and create alignment to drive progress will be critical. If you are energized by creative problem solving, creating transformational learning, building strong relationships, and managing through complexity to deliver business impact–this role is for you.

The ideal candidate for this role is…
- Strategic Learning Partner: Anticipates future learning needs by staying current with talent development and technology trends, thinks and solves problems systemically, balances long-term vision with execution rigor, and brings structure to ambiguity while managing competing priorities

- Bilingual in Learning + Human Centered Design: Skilled at translating design methodologies into effective learning strategies

- AI Readiness : On the cutting edge of modern technology and the impact AI is making to workforce readiness and talent development

- Product-minded: Applies iteration, experimentation, and feedback to improve solutions

- Collaborative: Thrives in matrixed environments and values co-creation when building alignment across the business, HR, and L&D

- Relationship Manager: Cultivates strong stakeholder relationships, acting as a trusted advisor to foster collaboration

- Insight-driven: Uses data and insights to drive decisions and continuous improvement

- Storyteller: Communicates with clarity and influence to senior and technical audiences

This is a visible role with the ability to impact change across the company and drive how learning is built and delivered at Capital One. To do this you will…
- Partner with Accountable Executives, HR leaders, and key business stakeholders to co-create the annual strategic learning agenda, defining vision, OKRs, operating and governance models, and ensuring seamless integration and execution across business and learning initiatives

- Collaborate with business partners to maximize knowledge sharing, peer learning, and optimize resource allocation to achieve the broader strategy

- Lead design and delivery of learning programs and iterates from feedback and data

- Project manage multiple initiatives, leading program teams and providing strategic support as needed

- Manage project scope, timelines, and budget, identifying and mitigating risks or escalating as necessary

- Own the measurement and evaluation strategy to ensure learning solutions deliver desired outcomes

- Collaborate on learner communications and external storytelling, sharing insights and outcomes about your work

Here is what you need to be successful:
- Experience educating, onboarding, and supporting large matrix organizations

- Experience partnering with key stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and define new initiatives for business impact

- Communicate effectively both written and verbally, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels

- Ability to manage ambiguity, lead through change, and deliver in a matrixed environment

- High level of initiative, ownership, and a customer-centric mindset

- Demonstrated success collaborating with other L&D professionals to drive efficiencies and share best practices

- Apply expertise in adult learning to shape learning strategy and products

- Comfort facilitating and leading training/workshops effectively, engaging at all levels

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelors Degree

- At least 3 years of experience in client facing consulting

- At least 2 years of experience in learning and development

- At least 1 year of experience in project management

- At least 1 year of experience in learning strategy creation

Preferred Qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience advising and influencing leadership

- 5+ years of management consulting experience

- 3+ years of experience in strategy creation

- Familiarity with change management

- Experience facilitating across a variety of modalities including in person and virtual programs

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Finance - Treasury
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Finance - Treasury

Senior Manager, Finance - Treasury

Do you want to leverage your analytical skills and be part of an exciting, fast-paced environment surrounded by smart, inclusive, and energetic individuals? Come and join our Capital One Travel Treasury team!

As a Senior Manager, Treasury, you will play a critical role in shaping our strategic direction while ensuring a well-managed operational environment. You will be at the forefront of identifying and mitigating risks, overseeing a team of treasury professionals, and acting as a key partner to our Senior Director. The ideal candidate will bring a horizontal mindset, an analytical eye, and a proven ability to lead cross-functional coordination. With an increasing volume of complex cash management requests, we are looking for a strategic thinker who can design robust funding strategies while maintaining flawless execution and a strong control environment.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):
- Strategic Treasury Ownership : Own liquidity and cash management, cash forecasting methodology, treasury KPIs and dashboards, funding strategy, and bank account strategy and controls.
- Complex Problem Solving : Drive strategic decision-making to support an increased volume of specialized cash management requests and initiatives
- Cross-Functional Coordination & Relationship Management: Manage internal and external relationships with key stakeholders, serving as the primary bridge between Treasury and cross-divisional teams, external partners, and financial institutions.

jobs.description:
White Collar Factory (95009), United Kingdom, London, London

Manager, Strategy and Analytics

Manager, Business Analysis
Location: London or Nottingham, United Kingdom (Hybrid)
Working Pattern: 3 days in-office (Tuesday-Thursday) and 2 days remote.

Our Mission:
We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role:
As a Manager in Business Analysis within our UK Card division, you will bring strategic and quantitative insight to address high-impact enterprise challenges. Sitting at the intersection of strategy, data, product, and technology, you will lead key initiatives to design, test, and deliver strategies that support our customers and their financial wellbeing. You will thrive in a collaborative environment built on shared accountability, continuous learning, and innovation.

What you’ll do:
- Strategic Leadership: Shape business strategies that deliver sustainable growth, customer value, and commercial success in a changing market and regulatory landscape.
- Analytical & Credit Strategy: Deliver product-level modelling and analytics, enhancing credit performance by connecting future credit trends to historical data, refining risk models, and validating hypotheses.
- Product Strategy: Design customer-centric lending products and implement effective pricing strategies.
- Execution & Delivery: Sequence business intent, translate strategy into actionable technical and business requirements, and drive concurrent projects from concept to market delivery.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Product, Tech, Operations, Finance, and Risk teams to enhance quality, service, and commercial outcomes.
- Marketing & Insights: Translate customer insights into clear go-to-market strategies, customer experience concepts, and direct-to-consumer marketing approaches.
- Mentorship & Leadership Trajectory: Drive immediate impact as a senior individual contributor while mentoring peers, with opportunities to progress into direct people leadership as you scale your impact within the team.

The skills and experience you need:
- Professional Experience: Experience in management consulting, financial services, or a quantitative strategy/analytics role, with a track record of translating analysis into implemented business strategies.
- Analytical Problem-Solving: Strong quantitative orientation with a proven ability to pair conceptual thinking with analytical rigour to solve complex, unstructured problems.
- Communication & Influence: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear strategic narratives and build alignment across stakeholders.
- Inclusive Leadership: Experience leading projects end-to-end, guiding cross-functional partners, fostering shared accountability, and cultivating an inclusive team environment.

Nice to Have:
- Technical Aptitude: Experience with SQL or Python is a plus. If you bring a willingness to learn, we will provide the tools and support to help you build these skills.
- Educational Background: A degree in a quantitative/ analytical discipline (e.g., Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.

Where and How You'll Work:
- This permanent position offers hybrid flexibility based in either our London or Nottingham office.
- We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.
- Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft. Our London office boasts a rooftop running track and coffee bar.
- Cross-Site Travel: Approximately twice monthly to foster collaboration across both office locations.

What’s in it for you:
We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:
- Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes
- Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
- Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
- Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

A full list of our benefits is available here .

What you should know about how we recruit:
- We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.
- We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.
- Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

jobs.description:
Principal Risk Specialist, CRA Strategy & Program Management

Within Capital One, Global Enterprise Affairs (GEA) is an organization dedicated to delivering on Capital One’s Mission by strengthening our reputation, deepening our relationships in our communities, managing engagement with the federal bank regulatory agencies, and serving as Capital One’s voice in the legislative and political processes at the federal, state and local levels. The GEA organization comprises Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) Strategy & Program Management, Global Policy Affairs Group, Regulatory Affairs, Global Enterprise Communications, Community Finance, Community Impact & Investment, and the GEA Command Center.

The CRA Strategy & Program Management (S&PM) team partners with lines of business across the enterprise to sustain Capital One’s longstanding Outstanding CRA performance. We maintain high data quality and control standards, and develop and support effective strategies with each applicable business. Most importantly, we manage CRA examinations by showing the bank examiners how Capital One effectively responds to the lending, investment, and service needs of the communities where we do business. We convey Capital One's comprehensive and durable approach to improving the financial well-being of low- and moderate-income people and neighborhoods.

The CRA Strategy & Program Management Data Management, Analysis, Technology & Automation (DATA) team seeks a highly analytical, self-directed, and dedicated professional to assume a pivotal technology risk management role. The successful candidate will contribute directly to maintaining the organization's record of Outstanding CRA performance by overseeing the accuracy and completeness of regulatory data workflows, ensuring rigorous quality assurance, and enforcing alignment with established technology compliance and information security control frameworks.

Responsibilities:
- Provide operational support for governance, risk management, and compliance control processes.
- Deliver strategic risk advisory services and oversight for technology-related operations, offering expert guidance across assigned business functions.
- Cultivate and sustain key stakeholder partnerships to foster cross-functional collaboration throughout the enterprise.
- Identify, monitor, and manage risk events and issues to safeguard the organization. Partner with relevant business units to execute remediation strategies.
- Maintain operational oversight to verify that assigned controls function as intended, ensure alignment with corporate policies and standards, and deliver specialized risk consulting.
- Conduct rigorous evaluations of control designs, execute effective challenges, and drive continuous control optimization.
- Collaborate with technology partners to enhance operational efficiency and advance process automation.

- Strong problem-solving, oral and written communication skills
- Strong organizational skills and ability to effectively prioritize
- Very strong attention to detail with the ability to focus on data and quality control
- Demonstrated ability to work independently, perform and influence others in a fast-paced environment
- Propensity to identify and assess potential risks in the processes
- Experience assisting in updating team policies and standards
- Programming and data visualization skills are preferred
- Fluency with SQL, databases, spreadsheets and presentations, including pivot tables, basic formulas, and charts

- Bachelor’s degree or Military experience

- At least 2 years of project management experience leading cross functional projects and programs in Risk
- At least 2 years of experience in the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) field

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Corporate Development Integration
jobs.description:
Director, Product Management - Corporate Development Integration

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About the Team
Our product team is part of a larger group focused on the transformation of Finance at Capital One.  The Corporate Development arm of Finance is responsible for assisting in creating new partnerships for our lines of business in addition to identifying possible acquisitions. The product team is a close partner in solving for how we accelerate time to value in these engagements.

The Director, Product Management for Corporate Development Integration is a unique and high profile role that is responsible for taking a holistic view of how we assimilate and integrate an acquired company into the Finance ecosystem.  You’ll work across the Finance portfolio shaping the strategy for how and when we integrate systems and assist the teams responsible for delivering on their individual parts of this agenda to engage effectively with their new counterparts.  You will be the wide angle lens on the strategy for how we integrate as well as the glue to keep the individual workstreams aligned.

In addition to your contributions on overall portfolio and product strategies, you’ll also play a key role in building our Product Management organization. You’ll help shape our culture and our people, provide mentorship for your teammates and be an ambassador for Product Management across the Finance organization.

As the Director, Product Management, you will:
- Create and provide frameworks for regularly and systematically using data to assess opportunities, track integration delivery performance, and drive decision making

- Set the vision, establish or refine patterns and create enablers for how we integrate different types of new partnership deals or acquisitions

- Confidently communicate possible integrations strategy, risks and opportunities across large organizations and executives

- Align the right support or resources to deliver on specific goals or enablers for future opportunities

- Prioritize, negotiate and remove blockers to orchestrate successful integration

- Inspire, enable and empower teams to execute with a sense of urgency to deliver solutions and on priorities

- Influence cross-department agendas proactively to deliver outcomes while balancing short and long term objectives

- Serve as a thought leader, contributing practitioner, career guide, and mentor to teams

What we are looking for:
- Proven experience in and passion for ideating, building and implementing great digital products

- Experience in organizational change management including transforming and improving ways of working and interaction models

- Exceptional communication skills -- an engaging storyteller at ease presenting to executives

- Creative problem solver who provides leadership at the intersection of the human, business and technology dimensions.

- Blend of both strategic and tactical thinking -- someone who can identify and prioritize opportunities in highly ambiguous contexts, and then organize work in deep detail; aligning long term vision with iterative execution

- Aptitude to champion strategic technology initiatives to leap-frog current constraints and deliver transformational value

- Strong quantitative background to support data-informed decision making

- Collaborative, team player attitude with the ability to navigate and influence the organization

- Superior problem-solving skills with strong strategic, white-spacing thinking

- Inspiring leader

Capital One Product Framework
In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:
- Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
- Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
- Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
- Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
- Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 5 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

Principal Associate, Financial Planning & Analysis - Financial Services

As a Principal Associate, Financial Analysis in the Financial Services division, you will work for a forward leaning organization that is actively disrupting the Auto finance industry through innovation and a customer-centric approach. If you thrive at the intersection of complex data, executive storytelling, and customer-centric strategy, this role will give you the platform to make a definitive impact.

You will have the opportunity to partner with business customers on driving strategic business direction that leads to sustainable performance and you will be asked to challenge our current well-managed processes to be more proactive, effective and efficient.

Financial Analysts utilize a wide array of tools and data to perform analysis to identify drivers and trends that impact the near and long term trajectory of our division. Associates have the resources and space to drive significant change across the team and organization.

- Navigate Ambiguity with Precision : Thrive in a dynamic environment by transforming open-ended questions and ad-hoc requests into structured methodologies and clear project plans under tight deadlines.

- Elevate the Team : Serve as an analytical sounding board and mentor to junior analysts, raising the technical bar and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

General responsibilities include :
- Strategic Finance Partner : Establish trusted business partner relationships as the finance partner for the Head of Auto Servicing Customer Care & Auto Servicing CTO

- Model Strategic Sensitivities : Act as the analytical engine for our business partners. Leverage our modeling infrastructure to run complex P&L sensitivities, translating potential business decisions into actionable financial intelligence for senior leadership.

- Manage Complex Deliverables : Independently prioritize and drive large bodies of analytical work to completion, seamlessly managing stakeholder expectations and complex relationships within strict regulatory and business timelines.

- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

- At least 3 years of experience in financial analysis, financial modeling or a combination

Director, Business Strategy

About Capital One Canada
For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated. We pair data-driven strategy with the autonomy to take ownership of complex, high-impact challenges.

If you’re ready to redefine what’s possible and drive exponential growth, this is where you can create what’s next.

You will have the opportunity to flex skills as a general manager across credit, operations, and technology in a critical area of our business that is responsible for delivering over $1B in revenue, that is poised to lead a revolution in technology-led risk management and meaningfully invest in our customer agenda, with the right leadership in place.

jobs.description:
White Collar Factory (95009), United Kingdom, London, London

Senior Strategy Analyst

What you’ll do
You’ll join our Analytics department in one of our core teams; Marketing Strategy, Lending Strategy, Customer Management, Valuations, Financial Support or Fraud.

In this role, you’ll help us on our mission to Change Banking for Good by:
- Using your analytical skills to solve complex business challenges, finding patterns in the data and building new credit risk strategies. For example, you could determine who is most likely to use a credit limit increase responsibly, the optimal account terms on a price comparison website, or the best support for customers behind on payments.

- Optimising lending decisions to drive sustainable lending growth and improve customer experiences.

- Delivering strategic recommendations and bringing them to market - working with product, data and tech teams to deliver them.

- Ensuring good outcomes for customers by tracking and drawing insights from performance of credit decisions.

What you’ll need
- Enjoy solving analytical challenges

- Able to use technical skills to solve complex data problems. If you know how to use SQL and Python, that’s great. No worries if not, as we will help you learn

- Strong mathematical and critical thinking skills

- An open mindset in your approach to change and personal development

- Experience leading a project, and working with people at every level to see it through

- A university degree or equivalent

- Experience in consulting or financial services

Where and how you'll work
This permanent position offers the flexibility of being based in either our London or Nottingham office. We prioritise collaboration and connection, so you’ll be based in office three days a week, from Tuesday through to Thursday. To further foster teamwork, you'll also travel between offices twice a month. Mondays and Fridays are designated as company-wide virtual days.

What’s in it for you
We’re set up for growth – and that means in our people, as well as our business. You’ll get plenty of opportunities to learn and develop your career.

We love to give our Strategy Analysts the opportunity to rotate to roles across various teams, from Marketing and Lending strategy, to Customer Management and Valuations. This is part of our winning formula for creating great future leaders so this role is well suited to high performers looking for growth opportunities.

As well as that, you’ll get:
- Pension and bonus schemes

- 25 days’ holiday (and the option to buy up to 5 more)

- Private medical insurance

- Season ticket loans

- Cycle to work scheme

- Enhanced parental leave

If you’re based in Nottingham, you can use a fully-serviced gym, subsidised restaurant and mindfulness and music rooms. In London, you can sweat it out on our rooftop running track. See our full list of benefits here

What you should know about how we recruit
We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible. And we offer benefits that attract people at all ages and stages.

We also partner with organisations including the Women in Finance and Race At Work Charters, Stonewall and upReach to find people from every walk of life and help them thrive with us. We have a whole host of internal networks and support groups you could be involved in, to name a few:

- REACH – Race Equality and Culture Heritage group focuses on representation, retention and engagement for associates from minority ethnic groups and allies

- OutFront – to provide LGBTQ+ support for all associates

- Mind Your Mind – signposting support and promoting positive mental wellbeing for all

- Women in Tech – promoting an inclusive environment in tech

Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis

Capital One is seeking a culture-led, results-driven, and strategic problem solver to join the FP&A Tech Finance team as a Manager supporting Enterprise Data (eData). In this high-visibility role, you will serve as a dedicated finance business partner, advising Enterprise Product and Tech leadership on strategic decisions. You will own the monthly actuals and outlook processes, challenge the status quo, and build sustainable, efficient financial frameworks. As a Manager, you will provide leadership by forging relationships, leveraging insights to influence business actions, and acting as a work lead and mentor to empower junior members of the team to deliver their best work.

About the Enterprise Data (eData) Team

Since the beginning, Capital One has leveraged data to drive strategic decisions and create value for customers. The Enterprise Data (eData) organization is at the heart of this mission, building a modern data ecosystem of platforms, products, and processes. Our goal is to ensure data is well-managed, easy to govern, and easy to find, understand, and use so the business can deliver real-time, intelligent experiences. You will support teams that are responsible for some of the most impactful work at Capital One.

Key Responsibilities
- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a work lead for junior members on the team. Actively coach, mentor, and develop talent while independently managing, prioritizing, and delegating project workflows.

- Strategic OpEx Management: Take ownership of budget and forecast accuracy for your areas of responsibility. Build end-to-end, well-managed financial forecasting processes, and accurately explain key cost drivers, monthly variances, and annual financial trajectories.

- Executive Advising & Storytelling: Analyze complex financial results and translate them into clear, high-impact, “executive-ready” presentations. Tell the story of the financials within the context of business priorities to influence the Enterprise Product and Tech leadership teams.

- Financial Modeling & Business Cases: Build structured financial models to resolve ambiguity. Partner with leadership to assess the financial implications of corporate actions and imperatives.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Provide financial leadership to the team and key partners by leveraging financial insights to influence actions and results. Build strong relationships across the Tech Finance and partner ecosystems and work collaboratively to deliver on strategic agendas.

- Process Excellence & Improvement: Create well-managed, sustainable financial processes. Lead ad-hoc financial analyses under both open-ended and tight timelines.

​
What You Bring to the Team
- Intellectually Curious & Transparent: High personal and professional integrity, coupled with exceptional problem-solving skills, a desire to solve big problems, dig deeply into the truth through data, and maintain a high bar for excellence.

- Strategic-Minded & Proactive: A strong business sense with an intrinsic drive to anticipate needs, understand changing tech/industry forces, navigate white space comfortably, and see the bigger picture beyond the numbers to guide leadership through complex decisions.

- Structured Thinker & Strong Communicator: The ability to deal with ambiguity by assisting in the development of project objectives, distilling complex financial concepts into digestible insights, and presenting data-backed recommendations to senior audiences.

- Empathetic Leadership: A low-ego team player with grit. You possess a willingness to roll up your sleeves to help colleagues, manage work through others, foster collaboration, and elevate your team members when challenges arise.

​

- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

- At least 5 years of experience in financial analysis

- At least 5 years of experience with financial modeling

- At least 1 year of experience in a Financial Planning function

- At least 1 year of people management experience

- Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA), Finance, Economics, or Accounting

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis

Capital One is seeking a culture-led, results-driven, and strategic problem solver to join the FP&A Tech Finance team as a Manager supporting Enterprise Data (eData). In this high-visibility role, you will serve as a dedicated finance business partner, advising Enterprise Product and Tech leadership on strategic decisions. You will own the monthly actuals and outlook processes, challenge the status quo, and build sustainable, efficient financial frameworks. As a Manager, you will provide leadership by forging relationships, leveraging insights to influence business actions, and acting as a work lead and mentor to empower junior members of the team to deliver their best work.

About the Enterprise Data (eData) Team

Since the beginning, Capital One has leveraged data to drive strategic decisions and create value for customers. The Enterprise Data (eData) organization is at the heart of this mission, building a modern data ecosystem of platforms, products, and processes. Our goal is to ensure data is well-managed, easy to govern, and easy to find, understand, and use so the business can deliver real-time, intelligent experiences. You will support teams that are responsible for some of the most impactful work at Capital One.

Key Responsibilities
- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a work lead for junior members on the team. Actively coach, mentor, and develop talent while independently managing, prioritizing, and delegating project workflows.

- Strategic OpEx Management: Take ownership of budget and forecast accuracy for your areas of responsibility. Build end-to-end, well-managed financial forecasting processes, and accurately explain key cost drivers, monthly variances, and annual financial trajectories.

- Executive Advising & Storytelling: Analyze complex financial results and translate them into clear, high-impact, “executive-ready” presentations. Tell the story of the financials within the context of business priorities to influence the Enterprise Product and Tech leadership teams.

- Financial Modeling & Business Cases: Build structured financial models to resolve ambiguity. Partner with leadership to assess the financial implications of corporate actions and imperatives.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Provide financial leadership to the team and key partners by leveraging financial insights to influence actions and results. Build strong relationships across the Tech Finance and partner ecosystems and work collaboratively to deliver on strategic agendas.

- Process Excellence & Improvement: Create well-managed, sustainable financial processes. Lead ad-hoc financial analyses under both open-ended and tight timelines.

​
What You Bring to the Team
- Intellectually Curious & Transparent: High personal and professional integrity, coupled with exceptional problem-solving skills, a desire to solve big problems, dig deeply into the truth through data, and maintain a high bar for excellence.

- Strategic-Minded & Proactive: A strong business sense with an intrinsic drive to anticipate needs, understand changing tech/industry forces, navigate white space comfortably, and see the bigger picture beyond the numbers to guide leadership through complex decisions.

- Structured Thinker & Strong Communicator: The ability to deal with ambiguity by assisting in the development of project objectives, distilling complex financial concepts into digestible insights, and presenting data-backed recommendations to senior audiences.

- Empathetic Leadership: A low-ego team player with grit. You possess a willingness to roll up your sleeves to help colleagues, manage work through others, foster collaboration, and elevate your team members when challenges arise.

​
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

- At least 5 years of experience in financial analysis

- At least 5 years of experience with financial modeling

- At least 1 year of experience in a Financial Planning function

- At least 1 year of people management experience

​
Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA), Finance, Economics, or Accounting

- Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license

- 6+ years of financial analysis and modeling experience

- 3+ years in a Financial Planning function

- 2+ years of experience acting as a project lead, managing workflows, or mentoring junior team members

Manager, Financial Planning and Analysis

Capital One is seeking a culture-led, results-driven, and strategic Manager of Finance for Capital One Software. This is an exciting time for the Software team as we build momentum against recent product launches in data management and security. As a finance leader in this space, you will operate at the intersection of technology and finance, helping to scale a high-growth business unit within a top-tier financial institution.

Key Responsibilities
- Financial Analysis & Insights: Develop a deep understanding of Capital One Software’s end-to-end P&L to drive analytical insights into overall financial performance.

- Variance & Driver Analysis: Accurately analyze and explain key business drivers, monthly variances, and the income statement implications of strategic decisions and contract structures.

- Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with business leaders to provide strategic finance and accounting perspectives on net-new initiatives, customer engagements, and commercial pricing terms.

- Business Case Development: Build robust business cases and financial models to assess the viability and financial implications of new product launches, feature expansions, and ongoing growth efforts.

- Leadership Communications: Develop and deliver high-impact presentations for senior management that clearly articulate the outcomes of complex financial analysis and strategic recommendations.

- People Management: Serve as the work lead for 2–3 analysts. Actively coach, mentor, and develop associates while independently managing, prioritizing, and delegating team workflows.

- Articulate outcomes of analysis, critically evaluate option sets, and present data-backed recommendations to leadership.

Principal Associate, Financial Planning & Analysis

Capital One is seeking a motivated professional for a Principal Associate position for the PULSE Network organization in the Global Payment Network (GPN) Finance team.

The associate will perform core Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) duties for their organization, including managing monthly processes & forecasts, perform reporting and analysis to support presentation and ad hoc requests, preparing profit & loss or other statements, build reports for higher level associates, and conducting scenario planning to strategically advise senior leadership.

This role will also contribute to the storytelling that ultimately goes to the Finance Senior Leadership team including GPN Finance CFO.

As a Principal Finance Associate, you will have the opportunity to partner with Finance leads and Global Payment Network business partners on driving strategic business direction that leads to sustainable performance. You will also be asked to challenge our current processes to be more proactive, effective and efficient. This role is within the PULSE Line of Business Finance Organization and will report to the Senior Manager, PULSE FP&A. An ideal candidate will possess:
- Strong communication and influencing skills

- Analytical curiosity and problem solving skills

- Ability to independently manage and prioritize tasks

- Teamwork and a willingness to share knowledge/help others on the team when challenges arise

- Passion to learn and continuously develop traditional FP&A skills as well as technical skills (i.e. Advanced Excel, Anaplan, OneStream, Tableau, and Python)

Key Responsibilities:
- Planning for PULSE Revenue and Volume

- Deliver accurate, meaningful, and efficient financial forecasts and management reporting to help our partners deliver on their financial objectives

- Financial reporting and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial reporting, and P&L management

- Coordinate and collect input data from Business and Financial Analysts in different departments, check data integrity, summarize and convert data, run models, verify, analyze, and communicate output data

- Business presentations: Assist in development of presentations to communicate analysis results to senior audiences, clearly articulate outcomes of analysis to leadership teams

- Ad-hoc requests and special projects

Example Projects:
- Collaborating with business partners in Sales and Product Management to develop monthly forecasts of PULSE volume and rates to support appropriate and timely decision making, and ensuring forecasts are appropriately loaded into planning systems for consolidation with Corporate Finance

- Analyzing and reporting on causes of variances between forecasts, and between actual results and forecast

- Evaluate PULSE’s customer portfolio and broader economic trends in order to recommend opportunities for strategic growth

- Produce executive-level reporting of PULSE financial performance and projections, including deeper analysis of segment performance, especially for Capital One’s debit card volume

- Supporting the CCAR process with stress-testing of forecasts and related reporting

- Collaborating with Operations on any changes to system-based volume or revenue reporting

- Communicate strategic vision and outcomes to members of PULSE’s executive leadership team

jobs.title: Manager, TMPM Process & Risk Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Manager, TMPM Process & Risk Operations Lead

Are you an expert at deconstructing complex "tribal knowledge" into elegant, scalable systems? The Talent Management Performance Management Operational Excellence (TMPM OE) team is seeking a Process Strategist to move our talent and performance management operations from institutional memory, manually-heavy processes to institutional excellence. You will be the primary bridge between operational intent and execution, ensuring our processes are so clearly defined that they serve as the foundational blueprints for our Product Partners and process automation.

Key Responsibilities:
- Knowledge Externalization: Audit current "institutional knowledge" across the team to create high-fidelity process maps and logic trees. Ensure these processes are understandable by non-experts, specifically Product Partners and Product Ops.
- Systematic Optimization: Proactively identify friction points
in the existing processes. Leverage systematic thinking, AI tools, & partnership with programming team members to redesign these workflows for maximum efficiency before they are prioritized on the product development roadmap.
- Product Requirement Architecture: Translate optimized operational workflows into clear, logic-based requirements. You will ensure that product enhancements are built to support a "future-state" process rather than automating existing manual workarounds. Success is measured by the completeness of operational requirements provided to Product Partners; your goal is the total elimination of missed process dependencies prior to release.
- Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner with Product Operations to integrate these refined processes into their user support and incident management models, ensuring a seamless experience from back-end operations to front-line support.
- Intelligent Automation Inputs: Work ahead of the roadmap to prepare data and process logic that are automation ready enabling the team to quickly leverage emerging technologies for automated decisioning and reporting.
- Global Scalability: Ensure all process designs are modular and adaptable for international markets, removing regional "shadow processes" in favor of a unified global standard through partnership with Risk.
- End-to-End Workflow Redesign : Champion the holistic redesign of work processes and structures by deploying intelligent automation across repetitive processes while focusing on achieving system-level efficiency.

Success looks like:
- Systems Thinking: The ability to see the "big picture" of the talent & performance management ecosystem and understand how a change in one area impacts the entire lifecycle.
- Information Design: Mastery of process mapping tools (e.g., LucidChart, Visio) and the ability to turn "messy" conversations into structured documentation.
- Automation Curiosity: Practical experience or a strong aptitude for using systematic or AI tools to streamline workflows, draft documentation, or analyze process data.
- Translational Communication: The ability to speak "Operation" to the current team,”Programming Needs” to Analytic Partners, "Requirement" to the Product Managers, and "Support" to Product Ops.
- Bias for Clarity: A relentless drive to eliminate ambiguity. You aren't satisfied until a process is so clear it can be understood by someone on their first day.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
- At least 4 years in process, project management, or operations

Preferred Qualifications:
- 4+ years of successfully championing major process or system transformations/implementations

jobs.description:
Nottingham Trent House (95002), United Kingdom, Nottingham, Nottinghamshire

Finance (FP&A) Analyst

Job Title: Finance (FP&A) Analyst

Location: Nottingham - Hybrid

Working Pattern: 3 days in-office (Tuesday-Thursday) and 2 days remote.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About The Role

We are looking for a FP&A analyst to help drive our best-in-class FP&A team. As a team we are responsible for a myriad of critical items, including executive reporting, senior stakeholder engagement, insight-focused analysis of our portfolio, and team enablement (i.e. raising departmental technical aptitude). The role adds value to Finance’s business partnering capability by providing accurate and important information at the right time.

With the support of your manager, you will be responsible for the production of our suite of executive financial reporting and will be working with other Business Partners within the finance team to deliver the key messages for the business. The role also involves partnership with stakeholder teams within the US.

What you’ll do
- Synthesising and simplifying financial and non-financial data

- Supporting in production of Month End reports; Working with team members and the wider FP&A team to feed into monthly financials review (MFR) meetings and/or other reporting requirements

- Supporting delivery of Quarterly Financial reviews and other monthly/quarterly tasks at high quality and within deadlines

- Supporting ad hoc reporting requests from leadership

- Developing reporting to facilitate monitoring and communication of performance against targets or to support review of outlooks (i.e. forecasts) and budgets

- Ensuring reporting reflects the most up-to-date and accurate information available.

- Supporting in depth analysis into our portfolio to drive key financial insights

How you’ll be doing it
- Utilising all systems and applications relevant to the required outputs of the role (e.g., OneStream, Workday, G-Suite, Microsoft Office).

- Investigating new technologies and tools and supporting process improvement workstreams

- Using business knowledge to enable work to be focussed on finance priorities

- Pushing the envelope of our capabilities via new data and automation

- Focusing on key risks and opportunities

- Collaborating across finance teams to deliver business outcomes together

What we’re looking for
- Functional knowledge of accounting and financial principles (e.g. P&L, budget & forecast etc)

- Strong attention to detail and proactive approach to delivering results

- Strong analytical skills e.g. outlook variance, overall story, accuracy, spotting errors and asking the right questions

- Communication - within and outside Finance. Ability to tailor written and verbal comms as appropriate

- Relationship building and stakeholder management with teams internal and external to Finance

- Continuous improvement and change-agility mindset

- Technical skills/willingness to learn (e.g. familiarity with python, sql, snowflake, AI tools etc) a major plus!

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in our [Nottingham / London] office .
We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.
Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft.

What’s in it for you

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.
In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:
- Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes

- Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.

- Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.

- Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

​
A full list of our benefits is available here .

What you should know about how we recruit
We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.
We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.
Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates .

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Community Finance Senior Manager, Capital Officer (Originations) - Mid-Atlantic

About Capital One:
Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses, and commercial clients. Our goal is to create one of the nation's great banks, and we have the necessary ingredients: a strong balance sheet, resilient businesses, a massive customer franchise, strong analytical capabilities, and great people. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas, and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company—and a great place to work.

About Global Enterprise Affairs and the Originations Team:
Global Enterprise Affairs works with many external and internal stakeholders to envision and create a world of greater socioeconomic opportunity through advocating for an inclusive society, building thriving communities, and creating financial tools that enrich lives. Our teams include Communications, Community Impact and Investment (CI&I), Community Finance, CRA Strategy and Program Management, the Government and Political Affairs Group, Regulatory Relations, and Strategy and Engagement. Through our teams, we have unparalleled access to a diverse group of motivated changemakers similarly focused on the ingredients for a more perfect future.
Community Finance builds inclusive, thriving resident-centered communities that catalyze opportunity and promote well-being. The team originates debt and invests in the low income housing tax credit through proprietary and multi-investor fund structures.

Role:
We are seeking a Senior Manager with a demonstrated track record in affordable housing origination to join a team focused on sourcing mission- and strategy-aligned Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) multi-family housing development opportunities.  The ideal candidate brings established developer and syndicator relationships from day one, sound judgment operating within regulatory and credit constraints, and market intelligence to identify opportunities. Through your expertise and relationship-management skills, you will build upon our strong industry reputation while challenging the status quo and actively contributing to our next chapter of impact and innovation.

Primary Responsibilities Include:
- Identify, source and lead the origination efforts of construction to permanent debt and LIHTC equity investment opportunities

- Cultivate and develop deep relationships with Syndicator and developer partners, leveraging existing industry connections

- Provide market intelligence to inform sourcing strategy and deal flow

- Partner with internal teams to ensure adherence to regulatory and credit policies.

- Contribute to process improvements to enhance operational efficiency.

- Represent Capital One in relevant industry board and community engagements

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or military experience

- At least 5 years of experience in business development, underwriting, asset management, or portfolio management or any combination of the four in the field of affordable housing or commercial real estate

Preferred Qualifications:
- 6+ years of experience in affordable housing or community development

- 3+ years of experience with Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC)

- 4+ years of experience in community development lending or investments

jobs.description:
Capital One Shopping Tech, Staff Full Stack Engineer, Technical Chief of Staff (Remote - Eligible)

Capital One Shopping is a product organization that operates autonomously within Capital One. Our products (a browser extension, plus web and mobile apps) reach tens of millions of shoppers. To keep moving fast inside a large regulated enterprise, Shopping needs someone who holds the full picture of what the org is doing and where it is headed, and who uses that picture to clear the enterprise-level roadblocks in front of it.

You hold the current picture of what is happening across Shopping and what is coming next, represent that work to the wider Capital One enterprise, and get Shopping unblocked with enterprise platform, security, risk, compliance, and procurement teams. The role needs enough hands-on engineering depth to represent that work credibly to those teams.

What You'll Do:
- Keep a current, org-wide picture of Shopping's work: what teams are shipping now, what is planned, and where the technical and business dependencies sit.
- Use that knowledge to influence the enterprise ahead of need: line up the platform support, tools, access, and approvals that Shopping's future work will depend on, before they become blockers.
- Prepare and present Shopping's progress and goals to Capital One senior leadership, and secure the decisions, investment, and buy-in that the work needs.
- Navigate enterprise governance (security, risk, compliance, procurement, platform standards) on Shopping's behalf, and broker between Shopping and central platform and infrastructure teams.
- Drive cross-team dependency orchestration on major, cross-cutting efforts. This is an occasional need during big initiatives, not an ongoing program-management role.
- Represent Shopping's engineering firsthand. Explain and defend our architecture and technical choices directly to enterprise platform, security, and risk partners, with the depth to hold those conversations on your own.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
- At least 7 years of experience in all of the following: - Software engineering and solution architecture
- Enterprise architecture and design patterns
- Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)
- Data architecture

- 10+ years of experience in all of the following: - Software engineering and solution architecture
- Enterprise architecture and design patterns

- Designing and building distributed HPC and ML systems
- Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)
- Data architecture

jobs.description:
Fulfillment Operations Manager - PULSE

Looking for a “Fulfilling” process/operations leadership role within an exciting, growing network?

The PULSE Operations Fulfillment team executes processes vital to ensuring the timely and accurate onboarding setup of new network participants.

As Fulfillment Operations Manager, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end Fulfillment process including intake, keying, and review functions.

You will have direct management responsibilities for a team of ~5 domestic PULSE Operations associates, and indirect management responsibilities for up to 10+ offshore contractors that support Fulfillment.

You and your team will refine process monitoring to measure and manage throughput, timeliness, and quality of onboarding activities; monitoring performance trends and establishing benchmarks to ensure customer and internal partner service level targets are met.

You and your team will partner with Operations teammates to ensure Fulfillment processes are well-documented and that appropriate controls are in place and consistently performed to effectively manage process risk.

Lastly, you will collaborate with PULSE Product and Tech associates to explore how new technologies can help to redesign Fulfillment processes and improve the consistency and speed of Onboarding activities.

We are seeking dedicated, disciplined, process professionals who excel in a team environment and are experts in process improvement. This individual will have demonstrated that they can improve company processes in the past, resulting in saving time and resources for the company. This individual must be able to effectively communicate and influence partners across the company and across multiple levels of the organization. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt to a dynamic agile environment are essential to succeeding in this role. This individual must display strong leadership skills and be able to drive and motivate a team in delivering flawless execution of process improvement projects.

- Creating and validating processes
- Designing and producing metrics used to measure efficiency and effectiveness

- Analyzing, identifying, and correcting data issues with systems used or owned by a department
- Providing subject matter expertise on processes when representing the department in projects and other meetings
