jobs.title: Payments Settlement Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Farnborough (95987), United Kingdom, Farnborough,

Payments Settlement Operations Lead

Job Title: Payments Settlement Operations Lead

Location: Farnborough, London - Hybrid

Working Pattern: 2 days in-office and 3 days remote.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role

This role will have a wide range of responsibilities as part of a team managing settlement balancing, and reconciliations. This position will also be part of the team liaison to the enterprise-wide Legal, Compliance and Business Risk functions. This person will help to develop business-unit specific approaches and ensure accurate and timely implementation across all risk management disciplines and all areas in the International Settlement organization. This individual will support the business compliance and operational risk/control activities within Settlement which may include risk assessment, controls, procedure documentation, process design, control workflow/systems, reporting, testing, remediation and third-party management. This individual will evaluate current operations across International Settlement, to identify areas for enhancements and work with business partners to implement these processes. Actively manages and escalates risk and customer-impacting issues within the day-to-day role to management.

What you’ll do

- Provide financial and operational support on the DCI Settlement System daily controls, ensuring Settlement balances daily, and ensuring achievement of team objectives.
- Research and resolve daily Settlement discrepancies, Production issues and customer inquiries, collaborating with Business Partners to meet customer needs, in line with Risk and Compliance goals.
- Lead the team’s response to past due payments, including funds owed to and from DCI’s settlement agent. Ensure swift resolution of outstanding payments by collaborating with cross-functional teams and settlement agent contacts, actively removing roadblocks as necessary.
- Coach and mentor team members to provide premier customer service within SLAs, with a focus on expansion of knowledge with team members based Offshore. Provide cross training on team functions to maintain bench strength and ensure no single point of failure.
- Build the team’s knowledge on the DCI Balancing functions, ensuring all processes are mapped and documented with suitable controls in place, through ‘Operational Excellence’ tools and practices.
- Proactively identify improvement and automation opportunities, to facilitate continuous process improvements on daily controls, and mitigate future errors.
- Identify, investigate and implement opportunities for introduction of AI into daily controls activities, leveraging Gemini tools and acting as trailblazer for AI activities within the team.
- Act as a subject matter expert for all operational matters regarding clients’ use of the DCI Settlement system, building strategic relationships across multiple partners.
- Lead priority projects as necessary, taking ownership to fulfil requirements. Balance conflicting priorities as needed to ensure timely completion, and proactively provide progress updates.

The skills and experience you need

- Cross functional knowledge of the Payment Network Industry focusing on Financial Services, Compliance, Internal Audit, Risk or Operations.
- Google Suite knowledge and expertise, particularly in AI (Gemini and GEMS)
- Effective written and verbal communication skills with all levels of employees and management; including managing expectations, communicating issues, risks and opportunities.
- Certification in Control Self Assessment, Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager

Where and how you'll work
This is a permanent position based in our Farnborough office .
We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend two days a week in the office.

What’s in it for you
We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.
In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

- Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes

jobs.description:
Principal Associate, Benefits Plan Program Management

The Principal Associate, Benefits Plan Program Management plays a critical role in ensuring the seamless delivery, administration, and continuous improvement of the organization’s Health & Wellness and voluntary benefit programs. This individual serves as a key operational anchor, managing a portfolio of vendors (e.g., on-site clinics, dental, vision, mental health, education, family support and commuter), resolving complex issues, and supporting the successful execution of strategic initiatives and Request for Proposal (RFP) processes.  This individual must be able to work independently to drive work forward with support from internal and external partners.

Key Responsibilities
1. Vendor Management & Governance
- Own Plan Program Management for on-site clinics and pharmacies, dental, vision, life insurance, LTD, AD&PL, mental health, family formation and support, MSK, executive physicals, and commuter benefits.  Develop a network and build trust-based relationships with vendors and cross-functional partners to get work done.

- Performance Monitoring: Attend regular partner meetings and actively monitor vendor adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and performance guarantees (PGs) to ensure vendors deliver on contracts.

- Partner with Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) to execute all required vendor management tasks to ensure compliance and mitigate risk (e.g.,  business reviews, risk assessments, data share requests).

- Manage processes for on-site clinic staffing, including updating access in our vendor management portal and ensuring physical access to the campus.

- Continuous Improvement: Create analytics to leverage data to generate insights on vendor capabilities and recommend plan or program improvements based on benchmarking data, areas of employee abrasion, compliance updates, or emerging market trends.  Considers broader and longer term impact to create value. Stay up to date on new programs or offerings from vendors and support the Policy & Design team with input on investment decisions.

2. Operations & Program Administration
- Issue & Escalation Resolution: Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date issue logs for each vendor. Drive timely resolution of tracking items and document outcomes.

- Manage annual program implementation changes with vendors (excluding Workday feeds). Ensure changes are properly implemented and tested.

- Core Administration: Handle all administrative tasks related to the assigned plans with a sense of urgency, while balancing quality, to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Navigate any ambiguity to assess various situations to determine the proper course of action.

- Internal Communications: Own and maintain internal intranet pages for your plans to ensure benefit program information, FAQs, and resources are accurate and accessible. Partner with HR Communications to make needed changes.

3. Associate Experience
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Own complex, tier-3 employee escalations for your plans end-to-end. Work with members to understand the situation, investigate root causes, interface with vendors for resolutions, and implement processes or solutions to prevent future errors.

- Understand associate experience (how claims flow, customer service support, etc) to recommend and execute improvements.

- Oversee the monthly benefits and wellbeing newsletter to increase plan utilization and drive awareness of benefits.  Develop a project plan with monthly themes, partner with stakeholders to provide relevant content, socialize as needed to support key HR initiatives, and work with HR Communications on production.

- Leverage data to support key messages and partner with HR Communications to design and execute on a communications plan to drive understanding of benefit and how to access/ use. Review communications recommended by vendors and partner with HR Comms on a view point for which should be sent, and timing.  Provide input into the monthly wellbeing newsletter.

4. Strategic Initiatives & Growth
- RFP & RFI Support: Support team members responsible for plan design with Request for Proposals (RFPs) and Request for Information (RFIs) for new or expiring benefit programs, including evaluating vendor bids and participating in stakeholder reviews

- Implementation Support: Handle program implementation changes with vendors; ensure changes are properly implemented and tested.

- Proactively seeks out benefits knowledge to stay current on benefits products, industry innovations, and regulatory changes by attending webinars, reading industry publications, and participating in conferences.

5. Documentation
- Process Documentation: Author and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for vendor management and escalation workflows to ensure team business continuity.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

- 3+ years of experience working with H&W employee benefit plan vendor management

- Preferred Qualifications

- MBA or Master’s Degree

- Certified Employee Benefit Specialist (CEBS) or Certified Benefits Professional (CBP) designation

- 4 years of experience in H&W employee benefits for organizations with 10,000+ employees

- 5 years of experience with benefits vendor management

- Experience with benefits governance practices

- Solid business acumen, strategic thinker, and problem solver

- Strong analytical skills and knowledge of statistical analysis

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. jobs.description:
Data Analytics Manager - PULSE Risk & Compliance

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

We are seeking a highly analytical, Manager Data Analysis to join our Data Strategy team. In this role as a Manager, Data Analysis, you will help build the framework and manipulate/analyze large datasets to understand PULSE transaction anomalies and risk exposure.
This is a hybrid role designed for someone who speaks the language of machine learning, data architecture, and modeling, but also deeply understands regulatory frameworks, risk controls, and compliance mandates.
You will be responsible for ensuring that our data-driven strategies are not only highly effective and scalable, but also ethical, explainable, and strictly compliant with industry regulations.

If you are a recovering data scientist who loves policy, or a risk and compliance manager who writes Python on the weekends, this is the role for you.

What you’ll do:
- Drive current and future strategy by leveraging your analytical skills

- Assist with building and using models to test and validate data

- Work with vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments

- Be a part of growing and developing our brand in new and emerging markets

- Leverage analytics to create a customer experience above our peers

- Be a part of the full life cycle of projects and see end results

- Collaborate across business units

- Work with top talent in a fast paced, entrepreneurial environment where analytics and good data are a top priority

- Experience real work life balance, with little travel involved

On any given day you will be:
- Mining data to arrive at specific and crucial information for the organization

- Identifying and implementing process, data, and reporting improvements for the organization

- Working with large and complex databases containing millions to billions of records

- Improving operational efficiencies and effectiveness

- Conducting analysis to evaluate processes and tests

- Extracting and analyzing data to gauge product offerings

- Consulting on the design and implementation of new production and data storage systems

- Developing and implementing strategic tests of products, initiatives and marketing materials

An ideal candidate will be on the leading edge of Analytical technology with a passion for the newest and most innovative tools. Possessing strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills are also important. This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams. - Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 6 years of experience performing data analytics, or

- At least 4 years of experience performing professional data analysis work

- At least 4 years of experience performing programming

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

- At least 7 years of professional data analysis work experience

- At least 4 years of experience with Python, R, Spark or SQL

- At least 1 year of experience in people management

Velocity Black, a Capital One company, is a luxury lifestyle concierge powered by advanced technology and human expertise. jobs.title: Email Marketing Lead, Principal Associate
jobs.description:
Email Marketing Lead, Principal Associate

If you’re a ‘builder’, consider yourself highly organized (yet scrappy at heart), and love getting inside the mind of your customer, look no further.

We’re looking for an end-to-end customer relationship management (CRM) marketer (with a focus on email marketing) who will be part of our expansion to digital channels. You’ll play a critical role in not only owning this channel, but also building the system from the ground up. You’ll own standing up the email service provider (ESP) instance, collaborating with engineering, compliance, IT, and more to build our email marketing infrastructure, and then be the end-to-end orchestrator of what we hope is a robust CRM program to our critical audience of US and Canada merchants.

We’re looking for both a proven track record in owning an email and/or CRM program, as well as someone who ‘leans into’ data instead of away: you look for conversion metrics, NOT just vanity metrics of opens and clicks. You’ve been known to be dangerous enough with SQL or HTML (you know who you are). That said, at a baseline you are a marketer and haven’t forgotten your basic marketing skills (copywriting, eye for design, and attention to detail).

What You'll Do
- Email journeys: Design automated, trigger-based email sequences that seamlessly align with offline marketing touchpoints, including telemarketing calls, site visits, and direct mail campaigns.
- Project management: Project manage enterprise ESP rollouts and migrations, serving as a functional bridge between marketing requirements and engineering builds.
- SQL anyone? Write custom SQL queries for dynamic audience segmentation and directly inspect/troubleshoot HTML/CSS templates and copy.
- Lower funnel for the win: Evaluate campaign performance using lower-funnel conversion metrics—such as reactivation volume, Cost Per Reactivation (CPR), conversion rates, and funnel velocity—rather than relying on vanity opens and clicks.
- Attention to detail: Manage campaign Quality Assurance (QA), cross-client rendering checks, dynamic data validation, and strict alignment with regulatory compliance standards.
- Collaborative: Collaborate effectively across cross-functional engineering, analytics, and marketing teams while maintaining a continuous testing agenda and a curious, growth-oriented mindset.
- Copywriting & persuasion: Apply direct-response copywriting principles and sales psychology to write clear, persuasive email copy that drives customer action.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelors Degree or military experience
- At least 5 years of marketing operations and CRM experience, specifically leading the technical setup of email service provider (ESP) instances and managing data syncs with Salesforce.
- At least 4 years of hands-on experience with Salesforce architecture, Pardot (Account Engagement), or Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), including defining CRM fields and system integrations.
- At least 4 years of experience in direct-response email copywriting
- At least 5 years of experience evaluating marketing performance using lower-funnel conversion metrics (reactivation volume, CPR, velocity)

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelors in Marketing, Advertising, Communications or Consumer Behaviors
- Strong project management skills, organization skills, and attention to detail
- Demonstrated experience managing multiple stakeholders and working cross functionally
- At minimum 1 year of hands-on experience writing SQL queries for database segmentation and troubleshooting HTML/CSS templates
- Excellent communication skills, paired with constant testing and a curious, growth mindset
- Experience writing or auditing direct-response call scripts, field briefs, and objection-handling documentation.
- Experience navigating regulatory or legal compliance reviews for marketing operations
- 2+ years of vendor management

MBA Product Intern - Summer 2027

Key Role Details
- This is a full-time paid internship program spanning ten weeks from June through August 2027.

- Participation in the internship requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model , for the duration of the program.

- Interns will be evaluated for a full-time position within our MBA Development Program, with a start date approximately one year following the completion of the internship.

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

Basic Qualifications
- Currently pursuing a 2-year MBA with an expectation that your degree will be obtained by August 2028 or earlier

- Must be continuing in the same course of study of your MBA following completion of the internship

- Currently has:
- A Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing

OR
- A Bachelor’s degree in any field and 3 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications
- At least 2 years of experience leveraging data and customer insights to make strategic business decisions, influencing stakeholders to adopt proposed strategies, translating business strategy into roadmaps, and leading high functioning teams through execution

- MBA joint degrees with technical Master’s programs (e.g., MS/MBA)

- 4+ years professional experience in Tech, Data Science, Consulting, Strategy, or Financial Services

- Demonstrated interest and experience in product management, software delivery, data science, software engineering, or leveraging software to solve customer and business problems

MBA Product Internship - 2027
Product Manager MBA Interns at Capital One help build products that empower millions of customers to achieve financial success and thousands of employees to serve our customers. Our PMs are human-centered, business-focused, technology-driven leaders. They are at the forefront of Capital One’s mandate to bring cutting-edge technology to the challenges of financial services. They are strong collaborators and communicators, comfortable working on cross-functional teams and creating a culture of radical transparency across stakeholders.

Product management roles at our company are as diverse as our business itself. We have teams dedicated to core products like credit cards, rewards, travel, and mobile payments, alongside critical functions like fraud detection, financial inclusion, and network growth. We also build robust platforms powering data and machine learning, marketing, and customer service tools. Our MBA intern roles aim to give first-time and experienced PMs the chance to learn new skills and disciplines, the exposure to solve real and impactful business and customer problems at massive scale, and the opportunity to develop as a well-rounded cross-functional business leader.

If you're interested in a long-term career at Capital One, this internship could be a great way to begin your career journey! As part of the intern experience, you will spend 10 weeks at Capital One and have a chance to:
- Join a specific team for the duration of your internship to experience what day-to-day life at Capital One looks like

- Work on delivering real, impactful projects as part of your team

- Hear from senior leadership and learn about Capital One overall

- Cultivate relationships with fellow interns and with associates across the company

Specific responsibilities may include, but are not limited to -
- Product strategy : Own success and life cycle of features for a product and/or platform, setting its strategy in line with overall business goals and driving prioritization decisions toward improvements. Translate business strategy into products; solve the right problems by deeply understanding our business, developing customer empathy, and integrating multiple streams of data

- Hypothesis-driven problem solving : Develop hypotheses and set up your own analytical frameworks to test for the best solutions. Scope operational feasibility, lead implementation efforts and monitor the success of new initiatives

- Leadership: Manage sprint team to ship, scale, and improve products that delight our customers and position company for substantial growth

- Results: Test and learn your way to something new while taking into account business strategy, market analysis, user feedback, analytics, and technology best practices. Take action, get around roadblocks, and stay focused on goals. Well-organized and able to juggle multiple deliverables while always utilizing data analysis, technology, and human-centered design to keep the customer goal in mind. Actively manage a backlog, make trade-off decisions, and clear impediments for your team

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work with experts to craft and drive long-term business strategy. Prepared to learn from a network of developers, designers, analysts, data scientists, customers, and other subject-matter experts and leverage them to build cutting-edge products

- Partnership: Manage work in an energetic and collaborative team environment by rallying disparate groups with different motivations to pursue a common goal, putting others ahead of yourself to help get the best results

Key skills include, but are not limited to -
- Innovative, comfortable with ambiguity: Displays entrepreneurial spirit with an aptitude and interest in learning to build new products and platforms with tech solutions. Able to handle undefined complex problems, and prepared to analyze a problem from all angles

- Human-centered, customer-focused, and curious: Eager to connect with customers, both internal and external, to deliver products that will have meaningful impact. Ready to ask, explore, and voice unique perspectives or crazy ideas. Fueled by a hunger to learn, and constantly seeking new challenges. Ability to dive into the details of products and understand how they work at an atomic level

- Strong business judgment, leadership, and integrity: A tenacious decision-maker bringing a healthy and aggressive, yet responsible, approach to business

- Great communicator and influencer: Ability to keep stakeholders in the loop and communicate complex ideas clearly to make sure co-workers understand the “why” behind their work and their key priorities. Able to build a culture of radical transparency

jobs.title: Senior Business Manager, Marketing & Analytics | Capital One Business Travel
jobs.description:
Senior Business Manager, Marketing & Analytics | Capital One Business Travel

Capital One Business Travel (COBT) , the booking travel platform for Small/Medium Enterprises, as part of the Premium Products and Experiences (PPX) team, is one of the fastest-growing parts of the business, having grown ~300% YoY. The platform continues to see exponential growth and has an ambition to maintain 2.5-3.5x growth over the next few years. The Strategy and Growth team is focused on driving multifaceted strategies to drive cardmember engagement and spend growth on the platform through various marketing initiatives to existing and prospective users. We are looking for a Senior Business Manager to join our team to lead and own our overall go-to-market strategy.

The role will be responsible for driving the end-to-end go-to-market (GTM) strategy for COBT, setting the vision and direction across several high-impact growth initiatives. Key priorities include building a long-term marketing roadmap, standing up a robust channel strategy, and establishing always-on customer and competitor insights to continuously refine our market positioning. Additionally, this leader will oversee performance-driven marketing analytics, drive our Field strategy to deepen engagement with managed accounts, and partner closely with Business Cards & Payments (BC&P) to align cross-functional priorities. This role will serve as a people leader for a high-performing team of 3-4 managers and analysts, guiding strategic analysis, cross-functional execution, and career development.

Summary: As a Senior Manager, Business Analysis at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You will lead and team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you'll do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

General Responsibilities:
- Strategic leadership: Develop business strategies that will drive growth, profitability, and competitive success for Capital One in the face of shifting consumer and regulatory behavior

- Business ownership: Have an ownership mindset, and potentially P&L accountability for a business segment. Strategic planning with a 1-6 month horizon

- Leadership: May manage and develop a team of analysts. Coaching and mentoring associates throughout the organization with a goal of developing and retaining talent at Capital One

- Product: Develop and implement new product and pricing strategies for various lending products; lead product level modeling/analytics

- Marketing: Lead direct to consumer marketing efforts for select products, and strategic intent for products distributed through various channels. Build targeted insights to inform the design and development of new customer experiences, as well as breakthrough technology and concepts designed to deliver on new go-to-market strategies

- Credit Risk: Drive step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer credit trends to historical behavior, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysis

- Execution: Coordinate across the line of business to manage and sequence delivery of business intent, build business requirements and execute against the product strategy. Oversee multiple projects and programs concurrently

- Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including: IT, Sales, Operations, Finance and others to drive improvement in quality, volume, service, and profitability

- Strategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytic marketing & credit risk management

- Strong business judgment, leadership and integrity: He/she should be a tenacious decision maker, able to bring a healthy, aggressive, yet responsible approach to business

- Solid people leadership experience: Ability to build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team, as well as business partners across the enterprise. He/she should foster innovation, drive critical decisions, hold business partners accountable, and be able to consistently deliver results

- Strong executive communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills

- Clear results orientation: display an intense focus on achieving both short and long term goals. He/she should be able to drive and execute an agenda in an uncertain and fluid environment

- Successful track record of thriving in a fast paced, entrepreneurial and dynamic environment. Previous consulting experience is a plus

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree

- At least 3 years of experience performing quantitative analysis

- At least 3 years of experience performing qualitative analysis

- At least 1 year of experience performing people management

- At least 1 year of experience performing project management

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s Degree in Business or quantitative field such as Finance, Economics, Physical Sciences, Math, Statistics, Engineering

- 5+ years of experience in quantitative analysis

- 5+ years of experience in qualitative analysis

- 2+ years of experience in people management

- 2+ years of experience in product development

- 2+ years of experience in financial modeling

- 2+ years of experience in economic forecasting

- 2+ years of experience in project management

161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,

Senior Manager, Sales- Discover Payment Network

About Capital One Canada

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

We’re driven by what’s possible, leveraging the power of data and technology to empower innovative solutions, inspire one another to dream boldly, and take transformative ownership of decisions and outcomes that directly impact millions of Canadians. Every challenge is an opportunity to lead from the front, working together toward a shared vision that extends far beyond banking.

We balance high-performance with investment in your long-term success, ensuring you have the support you need to do your best work. Here, you’ll take full accountability for your path, upskilling through hands-on experience and mentorship, to turn your curiosity into a career built on your own terms.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

About the Role:

Reporting into the Director, Sales, This role is responsible for accelerating acceptance growth through direct merchant acquisition within target verticals in Canada. This role focuses on building a robust sales pipeline, directly engaging high-value enterprise merchants, and executing end-to-end commercial agreements. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to navigate deal approvals, ensure seamless integration, and directly impact transaction volume and network revenue goals.

Your Responsibilities
- Identify leads, develop proposals, respond to RFPs, and negotiate agreements directly with merchants to maximize network acceptance.
- Strategically identify and create innovative business cases to win new merchant acceptance deals with key internal stakeholder buy-in (Pricing, Legal, Risk, AML, and other internal partners).
- Collaborate with internal teams and gather feedback from customers or prospects to identify, develop, and implement new sales opportunities.
- Develop strong relationships to maintain and grow account relationships with internal and external partners to meet volume and revenue goals.
- Participate in industry exhibitions and conferences.
- Travel: This position will be travelling up to 50% of the time.

Basic  Qualifications:
- At least 8 years of experience in payments industry sales, business development, relationship management, strategy, operations, project management, or finance.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree or higher
- At least 9 years of experience in business development within FinTech, Credit or Debit payment networks, acquirer or processor environments, or commercial payments.
- Experience with technical payment emerging capabilities such as e-commerce gateways, contactless payment chips, digital wallets, or tokenization.
- Track record of independently closing enterprise-level merchant deals.

Working at Capital One

You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.
- Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.
- Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.
- Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

jobs.description:
HR Manager, Vertical Risk Advisor - Tech & Automation

The Human Resource Vertical Risk Advisor (HR VRA) will provide guidance and advice to business partners on implementing HR risk policies and programs. A successful candidate will apply their technology, automation, and data analytics capabilities to innovate HR risk management, drive process efficiency, and deliver actionable insights.The VRA will also provide day to day risk support across all facets of the Enterprise Risk Management framework, and will also partner with second line risk management functions, including Legal and Compliance to support business adherence with all applicable Employment and Privacy laws and ensure the Risk Management System of record, FUSE, accurately reflects process applicability and the control environment.

Ongoing Vertical Risk Advisor Support will provide support to lead VRA and business partners on key risk activities
- HR Risk Management and Reporting and Analytics: Support the development and enhancement of risk management and reporting, leveraging data analytics tools and creating automated dashboards to drive meaningful conversations, accountability and awareness in HR
- Process Automation & Efficiency : Design, build, and execute automated workflow solutions (e.g., scripts, automated risk tracking) to streamline routine risk assessments, control tracking, and reporting workflows through data tools
- HR Risk Assessments of new or changing intent to ensure new intent is assessed through appropriate forums
- HR Regulatory applicability: Partner with HR, Legal and Compliance to review and update regulatory applicability
- HR Controls : Accountable for Uncovered RMAP process,  identify and document appropriate controls, in the Risk Management system of record, FUSE
- HR Issues & Events: Provide support for HR Issues & Events; ensure adherence to Enterprise Risk Management standards and expectations
- HR Policies, Standards & Procedures : Support HR Policies through documentation in accordance with the Corporate Policy Office expectations and maintained in the compliance and reporting platform (Wdesk)
- Audits & Exams: Support for related audits and exams
- Regulatory Changes: Partner with HR, Legal and Compliance to assess impact of regulatory changes to both employment and privacy laws; document implementations plans, as appropriate to demonstrate compliance with requirements
- Advise on HR Functional Area documentation, Partner with HR to ensure process documentation meets enterprise requirements and is well managed
- HR Risk Assessment Support: Provide support of required Enterprise Assessments such as Process Criticality, Process Level Assessments and Risk and Control Self Assessment.
- Provide guidance and advice to business partners on implementing risk policies and programs

- High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent certification
- At least 5 years of risk management experience or at least 5 years of human resource experience or 5 years of business operations experience
- At least 2 years of process management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree

- 3+ years of experience in process management

- 3+ years of experience building dashboards and reporting solutions using business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

jobs.description:
Manager Data Analytics - Global Payment Network - Data Governance and Programs

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

The Manager, Data Analytics will join the Data Governance and Pricing (DGAP) team within the Global Payment Networks (GPN) to manage numerous data adjacent risks. The risks include, for example, the data aspects of Network Conflict Risk (NCR), External Data Sharing (XDS), SCAN Findings, Privacy, Feature and Script Governance, GDPR, CCPA, Interchange Fee Prohibition Act, and more. The candidate will bring a mixture of Data, Risk, and Project
Management experience to develop build overarching programs, establish controls and processes to mitigate risks across GPN. The ideal candidate will have an understanding of both the associated risk management frameworks and the applicable policies and standards.

What you’ll do:
- Drive current and future strategy by leveraging your analytical skills
- Assist with building and using models to test and validate data
- Work with vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments
- Be a part of growing and developing our brand in new and emerging markets
- Leverage analytics to create a customer experience above our peers
- Lead a team of talented junior analysts on an exciting professional journey while mentoring them and elevating their careers
- Be a part of the full life cycle of projects and see end results
- Collaborate across business units
- Work with top talent in a fast paced, entrepreneurial environment where analytics and good data are a top priority
- Experience real work life balance, with little travel involved

On any given day you will be:
- Mining data to arrive at specific and crucial information for the organization
- Identifying and implementing process, data, and reporting improvements for the organization
- Working with large and complex databases containing millions to billions of records
- Improving operational efficiencies and effectiveness
- Conducting analysis to evaluate processes and tests
- Extracting and analyzing data to gauge product offerings
- Consulting on the design and implementation of new production and data storage systems
- Developing and implementing strategic tests of products, initiatives and marketing materials

An ideal candidate will be on the leading edge of Analytical technology with a passion for the newest and most innovative tools. Possessing strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills are also important. This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams. Human Resource Operations - Immigration Specialist

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

jobs.description:
Compliance Director, Fair & Responsible Banking Compliance (Regulatory Consumer Center of Excellence)

The Fair and Responsible Banking (F&RB) function, part of the Enterprise Risk Organization's Compliance & Ethics department, is seeking a highly experienced, strategic, and forward-thinking Compliance Director.

This Director will assume overall responsibility for the development, delivery, and ongoing management of the new Consumer Center of Excellence, a compliance program responsible for the Enterprise standards and strategic oversight for:
- Multilingual governance to ensure compliance with the Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA),  Regulation B, and UDAAP/UDAP laws with respect to the provision of the multilingual customer experience

- Servicemember laws and protections (SCRA, MLA)

- Credit bureau furnishing and FCRA disputes

- FCRA prescreen advertising

This role will lead the development, maturation, and maintenance of programs and governance structures that allow Capital One’s businesses to offer financial products and services while strictly adhering to regulatory expectations.

Successful Directors in Fair and Responsible Banking Compliance are highly motivated professionals possessing deep subject matter expertise in compliance management systems and consumer protection laws, and who have a natural passion for managing risk coupled with strong project management, process, and analytical skills. The role requires strong organizational, leadership, and communication abilities and offers significant exposure to executives across various lines of business.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the development, maturation, and continuous enhancement of the Regulatory Consumer Center of Excellence compliance programs

- Provide robust oversight of these programs through strong governance, rigorous controls and monitoring, and clear risk escalation processes

- Report program results to senior management and stakeholders, as appropriate

- Develop, execute, and monitor work plans for the effective build out of the program and audit-ready program frameworks

- Cultivate a highly collaborative environment with other risk teams and partner groups to develop efficient engagement routines within an integrated and seamless risk experience for the business

- Effectively balance competing priorities and demonstrate the ability to adapt quickly to new information or circumstances to ensure team objectives are met

- Manage and develop a team of subject matter experts by fostering  positive team dynamics, a shared strategic vision, clear communication, and demonstrated emotional intelligence

- Provide thought leadership, training, and tools to inform the efficient and consistent execution of program requirements by first and second line teams across varied business areas

Competencies:

Leadership & Vision
- Define and drive the strategic vision for the Regulatory Consumer Center of Excellence compliance programs

- Inspire, motivate, and provide clear direction to the team to successfully execute strategic priorities

- Lead teams effectively through change and champion innovation within the compliance space

- Demonstrate strong leadership by driving and motivating the team to flawlessly execute process improvement projects

Risk Management & Regulatory Acumen
- Foster a robust culture of compliance risk management and balanced risk-taking

- Demonstrate knowledge of regulator expectations for consumer protection laws and effective compliance management systems

- Ensure the implementation of effective monitoring and other oversight mechanisms to proactively identify process breakdowns

- Provide expert guidance to the business, advising on comprehensive corrective action plans when issues arise

- Maintain a proactive, "forward-leaning" posture, staying current on regulatory and business changes to assess impacts on Capital One’s lines of business

Operational Excellence & Technical Aptitude
- Leverage technology, data analytics, and automation to build and maintain highly efficient and well-managed compliance programs

Skills & Attributes
- Communication & Influence: Possess exceptional executive communication, presentation, collaboration, and influencing skills across all levels and divisions

- Analytical Mindset: Exhibit strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, agile environment

- Business Judgment: Demonstrate proven capability to influence peers and leadership, building consensus through sound logic, rigorous analysis, and intellectual integrity

- Adaptability: Show independent and adaptive problem-solving skills, with the capacity to quickly adapt to a changing environment

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or military experience

- At least 5 years experience in building or leading programs within a consumer financial services institution or leading a regulatory compliance, legal, or audit function

- At least 5 years of people management experience

Preferred Qualifications
- Juris Doctor or other Master’s Degree

- 8+ years of people management experience

- 8+ years of program management experience leading cross functional programs in compliance and risk

- Expertise in consumer protection laws (e.g., FCRA, SCRA)

- Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM) or Certified Enterprise Risk Professional (CERP)

Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Manager, Data Science at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description:
As a Data Scientist in the PULSE Business Intelligence team, you will work closely with Pricing, Analytics and Relationship management, product and finance teams to deliver data-driven insights that support strategic business decisions. We focus on transforming complex large data into actionable intelligence that helps optimize pricing strategies, protect and grow revenue, strengthen relationships with partners and improve overall business performance. We are seeking a Data Scientist to support pricing strategy through advanced analytics, predictive modeling.

In this role, you will:
- Partner with a cross-functional team of pricing analysts, finance analysts, data analysts  and data engineers to optimize revenue.

- Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data

- Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation

- Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:
- Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.

- Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.

- Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.

- A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
- A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analytics

- A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field)  or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics

- A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analytics

- At least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis

- At least 1 year of experience working with machine learning

- At least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:
- PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics

- At least 1 year of experience working with AWS

- At least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysis

- At least 4 years’ experience with machine learning and statistical  modeling techniques.

- At least 4 years’ experience with SQL

- Experience with large-scale transaction datasets.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Sales Operations & Enablement
jobs.description:
Sr Manager, Sales Operations & Enablement

Capital One Travel is entering a new era of scale. As we transition our core systems to internal infrastructure, we are moving fast to build a world-class travel ecosystem. To accelerate this growth, we are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager of Sales Operations & Enablement to architect and execute our commercial "operating system."
Your core mandate is to design and implement the foundational infrastructure, playbooks, and incentive structures that allow our supply teams to scale contracted margin, traveler value, and supplier marketing spend. You will bridge the gap between "scrappy startup" execution and robust enterprise operations, ensuring our teams can drive massive commercial impact in a compliant, scalable, and highly repeatable way.

What You’ll Do
In this role, you will lead the strategic evolution of our commercial lifecycle. You will focus your impact across four core pillars:
1. Commercial Lifecycle & Playbook Architecture
- Define the Sales Engine: Map, document, and standardize the end-to-end commercial lifecycle, ensuring crisp stages and seamless hand-offs across compliance, legal, finance, product, customer service, and marketing.

- Standardize Complex Streams: Establish repeatable playbooks for diverse revenue and value streams including margin expansion, supplier-funded discounts, marketing campaigns, sponsored listings, and renewal strategies.

- Drive Institutional Clarity: Eliminate ambiguity by introducing clear functional accountability at every stage of the partner pipeline.

2. Tooling Evolution & Salesforce Business Design
- Product Manage our Stack: Own the business design of Salesforce and supporting commercial tools. Ensure our systems are designed around real-world workflows rather than forcing teams to adapt to rigid tools.

- Partner with Engineering: Collaborate with an Individual Contributor (IC) Salesforce Product Manager/Admin to engineer highly automated workflows that reduce manual burden, eliminate administrative friction for sellers, and adhere strictly to Capital One’s risk and compliance boundaries.

- Build a Single Source of Truth: Orchestrate deep integrations between Salesforce, internal operations systems (Jira), and Business Intelligence tools (Looker) to centralize accounts, opportunities, contracts, and campaigns.

3. Incentives & Governance Framework
- Motivate with Intent: Design, implement, and govern a coherent, unified sales incentive framework that aligns supply teams with core business priorities (contracted margin, marketing fund utilization, and cost savings).

- Automate & Validate: Tie compensation directly to verified data structures within Salesforce and Looker, removing the manual spreadsheet tracking burden from sales managers and finance partners while ensuring maximum transparency.

4. Data-Driven Enablement & Leadership Strategy
- Empower Commercial Leaders: Partner with Analytics to develop executive dashboards showcasing pipeline dynamics, win-rates, margin yield trends, and marketing ROI.

- Prove Financial Impact: Standardize how we measure and report the tangible value delivered by the commercial team (including cost savings from disputes and debit memos) to defend and expand future organizational investment.

- Equip Sellers for Enterprise Success: Deliver the materials, competitive insights, and localized plays needed by sales teams to capture premium traveler value and win enterprise-level partnerships.

What We’re Looking For
- The Transition Architect: You have a proven track record of moving teams from manual, ad-hoc processes to highly structured, automated sales operations models.

- The System Thinker: You understand how to translate business requirements into technical Salesforce architectures that scale.

- The Collaborative Influencer: You easily navigate matrixed organizations, building alignment between highly contrasting teams like Legal, Compliance, Finance, and fast-moving Sales organizations.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

-  At least 6 years of sales operations or process management experience

Preferred Qualifications
- Masters or MBA degree

- 5+ years of Salesforce experience

Senior Risk Managers at Capital One are highly motivated Risk Management professionals with excellent organizational and communication skills. They have a high level of exposure across lines of business and have the opportunity to work with executives to create and implement innovative solutions to identify and mitigate potential risks to the company.

The Vertical Risk Manager , Sr Manager, (VRM) within Card Risk Data, Models, Decisioning & Credit   (“DMDC”) supports Decisioning as a Service (DaaS), providing risk framework guidance across product, platforms, and the well managed execution of processes. VRMs act as the first line of defense, leading, advising, and innovating on top transformational initiatives while partnering with business leaders to identify and mitigate potential risks to Capital One. This role offers a high level of exposure across lines of business, where VRMs collaborate with Executives and their teams to deliver risk solutions that directly impact customer experience and ensure Capital One’s continued growth and success.

- Lead risk framework discussions and drive creative solutions to improve the risk profile
- Participate in risk forums and business reporting routines and contribute to continuous improvement of risk management practices
- Lead ad-hoc projects to improve processes or control environment to mitigate risks

jobs.description:
Inside Sales Manager

Inside Sales Manager

Are you a strategic leader who enjoys nurturing strong relationships among your team? Would you like to make an impact in the Relationship Management field? An Inside Sales Manager at Capital One leads, manages, and motivates a small team of Relationship Managers (Credit Buyers) by guiding them to succeed, thus allowing them to meet and exceed their loan origination performance objectives. This role monitors and grants credit exceptions in accordance with the Capital One policy and within the confines of individual credit level authority. Additionally, once a part of the Capital One team, you will provide training, coaching, and guidance to ensure effective understanding and adherence to all essential sales processes.

In addition to providing management oversight to the team, the Inside Sales Manager is also responsible for directly managing a territory of dealers. Here, the Inside Sales Manager has primary responsibility for driving business results with a defined set of dealers through ongoing relationship building and through the negotiation and decisioning of submitted applications.

Responsibilities:

- Ownership of the team’s recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and development of associate talent.
- Offer impact performance feedback through employee recognition, rewards, and disciplinary action.
- Guide employee’s success using a framework that encourages employee contribution, feedback, and growth.
- Empower career development planning and opportunities. Delegate responsibility and welcomes accountability and regular feedback.
- Foster a spirit of teamwork and cohesion aligning with Capital One’s open culture and the appreciation of diversity of people and thought.
- Strategically analyze data, statistics, and operational results transforming low outcomes into solutions.
- Manage employee work schedules including vacations, holidays, paid time off and overtime opportunities making sure the team needs are met.
- Foster a collaborative team by demonstrating transparent communications across the team by holding regular group and one on one meetings.
- Partner successfully with peers and teammates to efficiently achieve operational alignment and mutual objectives.

Schedule Expectations:

- Available ~3 Saturdays a month as needed to cover dealer inquiries and escalations with Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday off
- In office 5 days a week for the first 90 day training period
- Potential to work up to 2 Sundays a month with Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday off

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma, GED or Equivalent Certification
- At least 2 years of Financial Services Experience or Business to Business Sales Experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree
- 2+ years of experience in Indirect Auto Finance

jobs.description:
Principal Associate, Dealer Brand Manager (Auto)

Capital One Auto is seeking a data-driven Principal Associate, Dealer Brand Manager to own the integrated marketing efforts and outcomes that directly power our Sales Channel and deliver measurable business growth. This role sits at the critical intersection of Brand and Sales, acting as a catalyst to translate complex business strategies into high-impact, sales-ready narratives that drive dealer engagement and tangible results.

As a champion for our Dealer customers, you will drive the B2B growth strategy by empowering our teams with the tools, stories, and insights they need to win in the field. This is a business-integrated role requiring a blend of strategic vision, creative execution, and deep sales empathy. You will come to the table with the ability to understand the daily realities of the Sales Channel and deliver marketing solutions that reduce friction, handle objections, and drive conversion.

Responsibilities:
- Own the development of integrated Brand strategies that serve as the foundation for Sales Channel enablement, serving as an integral liaison between Brand and Sales.
- Build a deep understanding of Capital One Auto’s Dealer offerings and sales workflows, serving as a subject matter expert to ensure marketing material solves real-world sales challenges.
- Create overarching value propositions and sales narratives that resonate across internal sales meetings, external dealer presentations, and dealer-facing events, as needed.
- Own both the strategic development and outcome of marketing collateral and sales enablement toolkits that support the national Sales team in building and maintaining dealer relationships.
- Develop creative briefs and work closely with execution partners to bring sales intent to life via compelling, high-utility marketing deliverables.
- Synthesize dealer feedback, competitive landscape, and field insights to identify strategic recommendations that improve sales results and brand impact.
- Tell consistent and compelling stories about our products and services while ensuring the Sales team is equipped to champion the brand and the end-customer experience.
- Influence internal decision makers and Sales leadership with formal recommendations and informal networking through excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Champion well-managed processes to ensure the Sales Channel receives marketing support that is accurate, compliant, and delivered at the speed of the business.
- Partner with data and business teams to provide reporting on the impact of sales enablement efforts, helping surface key learnings that inform future channel strategy.

This Associate should bring:
- The ability to take a strategic and organized approach to marketing, turning broad business goals into fully fleshed-out sales enablement assets and campaigns.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, specifically the ability to partner with Sales leadership to understand their priorities and how marketing can help achieve them.
- A strategic mindset with the ability to quickly iterate and pivot based on direct feedback from the Sales Channel to achieve desired outcomes.
- An entrepreneurial spirit and a proactive drive to identify and fill gaps in the current sales collateral suite.
- Experience managing creative processes from a sales-first perspective, ensuring high-quality output that is practical for use in the field.
- Excellent judgment to manage multiple projects and changing sales priorities, while simultaneously maintaining high standards of accuracy.
- A passion for leveraging data and field insights to turn learnings into actionable implications for the Sales Channel and go-to-market approach.
- A curious mindset, ready to dig into dealer behaviors and sales obstacles to create marketing that solves for "the why behind the buy."
- Highly effective communication skills with outstanding writing, editing, and presentation abilities tailored for both internal and external audiences.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree or military experience
- At least 5 years of experience in brand marketing, B2B marketing, direct response marketing, or corporate communications (or a combination)

Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in financial services marketing.
- 3+ years of experience in a marketing or communications department for a Fortune 500 company or within an advertising/marketing agency.
- 2+ years of experience with automotive B2B marketing, automotive lending providers, or automotive SaaS providers.
- 2+ years of experience working directly in B2B Sales or working hand-in-hand with a national B2B Sales team to drive channel growth.

jobs.description:
245 Hammersmith (95989), United Kingdom, London,

Personal Assistant - International Marketing, Product and Business Development

Job Title: Personal Assistant
Location: Hammersmith, London - Hybrid
Working Pattern: 2 days in-office and 3 days remote.

About the role
We are seeking a detail-oriented, innovative, and confident Personal Assistant to partner with our International Marketing, Product and Business Development team. This highly visible, collaborative and pivotal role acts as a gatekeeper and extension of our leadership team, ensuring the success of a well-run, efficient organization.

As the central point of contact, you will partner closely with other administrative assistants, team members and the Chief of Staff team.  The ability to adapt to changing priorities, take on new and unfamiliar tasks, and work collaboratively with others is critical to the role.

The ideal candidate will exercise sound judgement, maintain strong attention to detail, and act with a proactive mindset, while bringing the highest level of integrity, trust, and confidentiality to the role to reinforce Capital One’s corporate culture of excellence.

What you'll do
Strategic Calendar Management:
- Proactively manage complex, global executive calendars across multiple time zones, prioritizing scheduling requests and adjusting to frequent last-minute changes with ease.

Travel & Expense Coordination:
- Handle complex domestic and international travel arrangements and create timely expense reports using Capital One systems.

Meeting & Event Planning:
- Arrange and reserve conference rooms, catering, audio/video, and other essential services for team events, all-hands meetings, and stakeholder forums.
- Drive key team planning for activities and events.

Communication & Ambassadorship:
- Serve as a central point of contact, circulating information, and acting as a team ambassador to foster strong relationships.
- Partner with the Communications team to assist with planning for internal and external speaking engagements.

Team Administration:
- Manage and own team distribution lists, organizational charts, shared calendars and support onboarding of new team members.

General Office Support:
- Supporting the office manager as needed with managing desk allocation, mail distribution, printing, and ad-hoc projects.

What we’re looking for
- Extensive experience as an Executive Assistant or Administrative Assistant in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (G-Suite).
- Experience utilizing AI tools such as Gemini, CoPilot, or Claude.
- Proficiency in video conferencing technology (Zoom, Teams, etc.).
- Exceptional written and verbal communications, organizational, and time management skills.

Where and how you'll work
This is a permanent position based in our Hammersmith, London office. We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend two days a week in the office.

What’s in it for you
We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.
In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes
Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

A full list of our benefits is available here .

What you should know about how we recruit
We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.
We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

Marketing Manager - Discover Card Products (Hybrid)

Capital One, a Fortune Magazine “100 Best Companies to Work For,” is seeking an innovative Marketing Manager to drive acquisition marketing strategy for Discover card products. This individual will curate acquisitions experiences that meet the needs of the everyday consumer looking to access credit and earn rewards. This role will be responsible for translating audience insights into marketing optimizations, designing learning agendas and collaborating with partners to launch new tactics. The marketer will be a member of the Discover Acquisition Marketing team which is responsible for managing the product positioning for credit cards and developing acquisition journeys to help customers find the right product for their lifestyle. In this role, you will have the opportunity to take your marketing, technical and strategy skills to the next level.

Responsibilities:
- Oversee development and execution of integrated, multi-channel (email, site, in-app messaging, etc) marketing campaigns on a national scale to drive customers to engage with credit card offerings and deliver a thoughtful communications experience through robust, always-on creative testing.

- Synthesize consumer research insights, marketing trends, competitive landscape, and macro external factors to identify new strategic recommendations to improve marketing and business results

- Partner closely with business analyst teams to understand total business performance and build on analysis to identify new opportunities and adjust marketing/testing strategies

- Translate and communicate business intent in a directive manner that partner teams can act on

- Serve as key marketing liaison and collaborate with cross-functional teams (business partners, creative teams, legal, compliance, etc) to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to drive product consideration and conversion

- Partner with internal and external creative and marketing technology teams to build and scale marketing tactics and optimization to drive lifts in KPIs, particularly conversion metrics

The ideal candidate:
- Thrives on collaboration with partner teams and is comfortable operating in a large, matrixed organization

jobs.title: Risk Manager - Channels and Shared Services (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Risk Manager - Channels and Shared Services (Hybrid)

As a Risk Manager in Capital One’s Card Risk Team you will apply your risk management, project management and analytical skills to our highest profile risk initiatives. Risk Managers are at the front line of defense to ensure our company remains stable and profitable. They lead, advise and innovate on top transformational initiatives across the businesses in the first line of defense and are responsible for working with business partners to identify and mitigate potential risks to Capital One. In this role you will have the opportunity to support Channels and Shared Services.

Risk Managers have a high level of exposure across lines of business and have the opportunity to partner with Executives and their teams to identify potential risks in an open, collaborative environment where new ideas and solutions are both welcomed and rewarded.

As a member of the Channels and Shared Services risk team within the Card Risk Office, you’ll be challenged to shape the risk mitigation strategy for one or more areas of Channels and Shared Services. You’ll work with various stakeholders to identify unmitigated risks and assist with opportunities to strengthen the control environment to reduce risks for the business while building lasting partnerships.

Risk Managers at Capital One are highly motivated risk management professionals with an ability to think critically and problem solve. They have a high level of exposure across lines of business and have the opportunity to work with senior management to create and implement innovative solutions to identify and mitigate potential risks to the Company. Risk Managers are expected to have excellent organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities:
- Work with business teams and other key stakeholders to help develop well-designed products, processes, marketing, and supporting technologies and implement risk management practices; support our business partners on risk / return trade-off decisions

- Lead risk-related initiatives and process/control overhauls, focusing on transforming manual detective frameworks into automated, full-file, real-time monitoring solutions.

- Stay abreast of the changing regulatory environment and understand the impacts to the business areas and lead mitigation efforts across impacted areas

- Lead ad-hoc projects to improve processes or control environment to mitigate risks

- Participates in risk forums and business reporting routines and contributes to continuous improvement of risk management practices

- Utilize advanced data analytics to perform deep-dive assessments, dissect complex risk scenarios, and connect localized root causes to broader business and technological impacts.

- Ground strategic decisions in rigorous, data-driven analytics to proactively identify, manage, and mitigate potential risks, maintaining stability and profitability.

- Set and deliver on our well-managed agenda

- Drive the end-to-end execution of Process Level Assessments (PLAs) and Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), providing independent challenge to ensure that the control environments for critical business processes remain robust and effective.

Here’s what we’re looking for in an ideal teammate:
- You are a critical thinker who seeks to understand the business, its processes, risks and control environment, grounding your decisions in rigorous analytics with a mission-driven focus to navigate ambiguity with ease.

- You convey complex risk information at the appropriate altitude and level of detail, tailoring your message to adapt to multiple audiences, and you possess the executive presence to confidently lead difficult discussions with senior leadership up through VP+.

- You exhibit outstanding influencing skills to effectively drive project / program efforts, leaning in to lead cross-functional groups to consensus, leverage a highly effective network, and effectively navigate dissension to steer partners down the "right path".

- You proactively manage stakeholders across all three lines of defense, anticipate customer/business reactions, and expertly champion the balance between customer experience risk and competing operational risks.

- You adapt to change, embrace bold ideas, and are intellectually curious. You like to ask questions, test assumptions, challenge conventional thinking, and consistently anticipate changing business and regulatory needs to propose real-time priorities.

- You develop influential relationships based upon shared risk objectives, creating energy and an environment that fosters trust, collaboration, and belonging while driving a culture of shared success.

- You do the right thing and lead by example. You possess a relentless focus on quality and timeliness, act with a growth-first mindset, and have a passion for coaching, investing in the betterment of the team, and upskilling peers as a talent multiplier.

- You enjoy challenges and love solving problems through root-cause analysis, connecting the dots between horizontal Enterprise initiatives and local initiatives to create solutions with a broad systemic impact.

Basic Qualifications:
- High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification

- At least 3 years of payments operations experience or risk management experience

- At least 3 years of experience in stakeholder relationship management

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree or military experience

- 5+ years of Project Management experience leading cross functional projects or programs in Risk

- 5+ years of Financial Services risk management experience
