jobs.title: Senior Manager Data Analytics - People Strategy & Analytics
jobs.description:
Senior Manager Data Analytics - People Strategy & Analytics

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Senior Manager, you will partner cross-functionally with teams throughout the company to validate business impacting analytical tools. You will enhance your technical and analytical skills, while also working with leaders to influence business strategies. With a network of hundreds of Data Analysts, Quants, and Data Scientists, challenging projects with an eye on the bottom line and a focus on work/life balance, we’ve created a dynamic environment with plenty of room for you to learn, grow, and realize your full potential.

On a given day you will be:
- Refining a new Enterprise-wide analytical tools validation framework

- Planning and executing validation projects

- Assessing the quality and risk of analytical tool methodologies across Capital One, and the nature of tools usage within those processes

- Understanding technical issues in analytical tools and assessing tools risks and opportunities

- Independently researching, identifying, and prototyping industry best practices for emerging analytical tools

- Communicating results clearly and concisely both verbally and through written communications via validation reports and presentations

- Leveraging education, colleagues and training opportunities to develop solutions to business problems

- Coaching and mentoring junior staff

An ideal candidate will possess strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills. This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams.

Basic Qualifications
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 7 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.

- At least 5 years of experience performing professional data analysis work

- At least 5 years of experience leading and developing with open source data technologies

- Master’s Degree or PhD in a Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field

- At least 7 years of experience in statistical or econometrics hands-on work

- At least 5 years of experience in financial services industry

Senior Financial Analyst

Analyze and forecast financial performance, management reports, products and processes as well as apply advanced forecasting techniques to key value driver forecasts. Develop and build forecasting models, research financial and economic trends for specific projects, and provide technical solutions for business analysis. Develop cost models to be used in individual area analysis. Forecast important business variables, generate monthly/quarterly business reviews, analyze both historical and forecasting results, and make business recommendations. Develop methodologies and processes that provide transparency of costs and cost drivers to recipient businesses, and analyze current financial results to identify and address evolving business issues and opportunities. Provide management and business clients with project statuses. Perform reporting and analysis to support presentation and ad-hoc requests.

- Articulate outcomes of analysis and relevant insights

- Partner with business leadership to assess the financial implications of ongoing efforts to grow the organization

- Develop presentations to communicate business and analysis results to senior leadership audiences

General Responsibilities:
- Financial analysis & reporting: Accurately analyze & explain key cost drivers and monthly variances, suggest actions to the business, and manage the regular reporting process

- Budgeting, forecasting, and Profit & Loss (P&L) management

- Process Excellence: maintain and develop well-managed BAU processes, with a focus on automation and process efficiency

- Business presentations: Assist in development of presentations to communicate analysis results to senior audiences, clearly articulate outcomes of analysis to leadership teams

- Ad-hoc requests and special projects

- Independently manage and prioritize personal workload, and orchestrate work across multiple stakeholders

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

- At least 2 years of experience in financial analysis

- At least 2 years of experience with financial modeling

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA) or Master’s Degree in Finance

- Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) license or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license

jobs.description:
Senior Risk Specialist, Compliance Governance Analyst

The Compliance Governance, Oversight and Validation (CGOV) team within Compliance & Ethics is seeking a collaborative, analytically-focused risk management professional to support our well-managed governance processes and protocols. This role is ideal for an individual who is adaptable to change, who embraces bold ideas and who is intellectually curious; and who is proficient in utilizing Google Suite, AI tools, Data solutions, and advanced risk methodologies to drive organizational effectiveness and maintain business integrity.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to carry out key governance activities, collect and analyze data, and implement meaningful process improvements. This position offers the opportunity to serve as a strategic partner to senior leaders by implementing and supporting Compliance Management Program methodologies , assessing risks, and serving as an ambassador for innovative, AI-driven workflows. This role requires highly motivated Risk Management professionals with excellent organizational and communication skills.

General Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:
- Coordinate Compliance Processes and Governance: Develop, coordinate, and mature internal processes and program governance, ensuring the efficiency and sustainability of key programs and initiatives.  Monitor day-to-day CGOV operations to ensure adherence to standards and methodologies, while proactively identifying and implementing process improvements and redesign initiatives.

- Establish and Manage Engagement Structures: Set up and maintain milestone meetings, folder organization, communication channels, and meeting minutes to ensure effective collaboration and communication.  Create meeting templates, coordinate template distribution, manage content inputs, and provide meeting facilitation support.

- Resolve Impediments and Support Compliance Organizational Priorities: Resolve or escalate impediments to deliver on top priorities in a timely and efficient manner, and assist in managing key deliverables across various initiatives.

- Audit/Exam Support: Assist with Compliance related audits and exams, engage in pre-planning, prepare and distribute status reports, track requests, timelines, milestones, and progress for key stakeholders. Design, implement and monitor relevant audit/exam remediation activities.

- Dashboard Governance: Manage intake requests for new or decommissioned Compliance dashboards; create and monitor new dashboards.

- Facilitate Reporting and Analytics: Support the gathering of insights and data, prepare written reports, and deliver oral presentations on identified issues and recommended remediation actions. Perform end-to-end outcome analysis, including the creation of relevant reporting updates to help leadership understand risk implications.

- Stakeholder Communic ation & Change Management: Communicate the results of assessments, process outcomes, refresher training, and issue management to ensure leadership remains informed on Compliance priorit ies and impactful change.

- Documentation: Support C&E Policies, Standards and Procedures (PSP) governance and create and maintain job aids to memorialize relevant processes and protocols.

- Tool Advocacy: Leverage and integrate AI tools—such as Gemini, Google Workspace, and NotebookLM—into daily workflows and serve as an ambassador to demonstrate their value to others.

- Monitoring & Quality Assurance: Design, implement and execute monitoring and quality assurance activities as needed to ensure consistency with expectation outlined in the Compliance Management Program.

- Collaboration: Participate in cross-functional project teams to provide input and partner with groups across the organization on larger strategic initiatives.

Ideal Candidates:
- Are critical thinkers who seek to understand the business, regulatory, process, risk and control environment

- Use data analysis to drive insights and propose solutions

- Foster an environment that promotes trust and belonging

- Possess a relentless focus on quality and timeliness

- Develop collaborative relationships within and outside of immediate team, based upon shared objectives

- Do the right thing and lead by example

- Communicate in a clear and compelling way to influence individuals at all levels

Basic Qualifications:

- High school diploma, GED, or equivalent certification

- At least 3 years of Compliance, Audit, or Risk Management experience

- At least 1 year of Financial Services experience

- At least 1 year of experience using Google Suite

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

- At least 2 years of experience in Project Management, Process Management, or Relationship Management

- Process Management, Project Management or Risk Management Certification

- Proficient in use of query and data visualization tools (Tableau)

- Experience using AI tools (Gemini, Workspace Studio, Gemini Notebook, etc.)

As a Principal Financial Analyst working in our Consumer Deposits revenue business, you will analyze financial performance, management reports, products and processes. You will forecast important business variables, gather and aggregate data results, generate monthly/quarterly business reviews, and make business recommendations. Additionally, you will develop processes that provide transparency of costs and cost drivers to recipient businesses, and analyze current financial results to identify and address evolving business issues and opportunities. You will be asked to challenge our current well-managed processes to be more proactive, effective and efficient. You will provide management and business clients with project statuses as well as perform reporting and analysis to support presentation and ad-hoc requests.

- Partner with business leadership to assess the financial implications of ongoing efforts to grow the organization

- Develop presentations to communicate business and analysis results to senior leadership audiences

General Responsibilities:
- Financial analysis & reporting: Accurately analyze & explain key cost drivers and monthly variances, suggest actions to the business, and manage the regular reporting process

- Budgeting, forecasting, and Profit & Loss (P&L) management

- Business presentations: Assist in development of presentations to communicate analysis results to senior audiences, clearly articulate outcomes of analysis to leadership teams

- Ad-hoc requests and special projects

jobs.description:
Principal Risk Specialist, Compliance Governance Analyst

The Compliance Governance, Oversight and Validation (CGOV) team within Compliance & Ethics is seeking a collaborative, analytically-focused risk management professional to support our well-managed governance processes and protocols. This role is ideal for an individual who is adaptable to change, who embraces bold ideas and who is intellectually curious; and who is proficient in utilizing Google Suite, AI tools, and advanced risk methodologies to drive organizational effectiveness and maintain business integrity.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to carry out key governance activities, collect and analyze data, and implement meaningful process improvements. This position offers the opportunity to serve as a strategic partner to senior leaders by tracking audit commitments, assessing risks, and serving as an ambassador for innovative, AI-driven workflows. This role requires highly motivated Risk Management professionals with excellent organizational and communication skills.

General Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:
- Coordinate Compliance Processes and Governance: Develop, coordinate, and mature internal processes and program governance, ensuring the efficiency and sustainability of key programs and initiatives.  Monitor day-to-day CGOV operations to ensure adherence to standards, while proactively identifying and implementing process improvements and redesign initiatives.

- Establish and Manage Engagement Structures: Set up and maintain milestone meetings, folder organization, communication channels, and meeting minutes to ensure effective collaboration and communication.  Create meeting templates, coordinate template distribution, manage content inputs, and provide meeting facilitation support.

- Resolve Impediments and Support Compliance Organizational Priorities: Resolve or escalate impediments to deliver on top priorities in a timely and efficient manner, and assist in managing key deliverables across various initiatives.

- Audit/Exam Support: Assist with Compliance related audits and exams, engage in pre-planning, prepare and distribute status reports, track requests, timelines, milestones, and progress for key stakeholders. Design, implement and monitor relevant audit/exam remediation activities.

- Dashboard Governance: Manage intake requests for new or decommissioned Compliance dashboards; create and monitor new dashboards.

- Facilitate Reporting and Analytics: Support the gathering of insights and data, prepare written reports, and deliver oral presentations on identified issues and recommended remediation actions. Perform end-to-end outcome analysis, including the creation of relevant reporting updates to help leadership understand risk implications.

- Stakeholder Communic ation & Change Management: Communicate the results of assessments, process outcomes, and issue management to ensure leadership remains informed on Compliance priorit ies and impactful change.

- Documentation: Support C&E Policies, Standards and Procedures (PSP) governance and create and maintain job aids to memorialize relevant processes and protocols.

- Information Management and Business Continuity: Provide support to Business Area Information Management (BAIM) and Business Continuity Planning, including managing access requests and maintaining governance for departmental records.

- Tool Advocacy: Leverage and integrate AI tools—such as Gemini, Google Workspace, and NotebookLM—into daily workflows and serve as an ambassador to demonstrate their value to others.

- Monitoring & Quality Assurance: Design, implement and execute monitoring and quality assurance activities as needed to ensure consistency with expectation outlined in the Compliance Management Program.

- Collaboration: Participate in cross-functional project teams to provide input and partner with groups across the organization on larger strategic initiatives.

Ideal Candidates:
- Are critical thinkers who seek to understand the business, regulatory, process, risk and control environment

- Foster an environment that promotes trust and belonging

- Possess a relentless focus on quality and timeliness

- Develop collaborative relationships within and outside of immediate team, based upon shared objectives

- Do the right thing and lead by example

- Communicate in a clear and compelling way to influence individuals at all levels

Basic Qualifications:
- High school diploma, GED, or equivalent certification

- At least 4 years of Compliance, Audit, or Risk Management experience

- At least 2 years of Financial Services experience

- At least 2 years of experience using Google Suite

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

- At least 3 years of experience in Project Management, Process Management, or Relationship Management

- Process Management, Project Management or Risk Management Certification

- Proficient in use of query and data visualization tools (Tableau)

- Experience using AI tools (Gemini, Workspace Studio, Gemini Notebook, etc.)

jobs.description:
Senior Manager Data Analytics - Global Payment Network - Data Governance and Programs

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

The Senior Manager, Data Analysis will join the Data Governance and Pricing (DGAP) team within the Global Payment Networks (GPN) to manage numerous data adjacent risks. The risks include, for example, the data aspects of Network Conflict Risk (NCR), External Data Sharing (XDS), SCAN Findings, Privacy, Feature and Script Governance, GDPR, CCPA, Interchange Fee Prohibition Act, and more. The candidate will bring a mixture of Data, Risk, and Project
Management experience to develop build overarching programs, establish controls and processes to mitigate risks across GPN. The ideal candidate will have an understanding of both the associated risk management frameworks and the applicable policies and standards.

On a given day you will be:
- Refining a new Enterprise-wide analytical tools validation framework

- Planning and executing validation projects

- Assessing the quality and risk of analytical tool methodologies across Capital One, and the nature of tools usage within those processes

- Understanding technical issues in analytical tools and assessing tools risks and opportunities

- Independently researching, identifying, and prototyping industry best practices for emerging analytical tools

- Communicating results clearly and concisely both verbally and through written communications via validation reports and presentations

- Leveraging education, colleagues and training opportunities to develop solutions to business problems

- Coaching and mentoring junior staff

An ideal candidate will possess strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills. This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams.

Basic Qualifications
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 7 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.

- At least 5 years of experience performing professional data analysis work

- At least 5 years of experience leading and developing with open source data technologies

- At least 2 years of experience managing people

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s Degree or PhD in a Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field

- At least 7 years of experience in statistical or econometrics hands-on work

- At least 5 years of experience manipulating and performing analysis with large data sets

- At least 5 years of experience in financial services industry

- At least 5 years of experience in developing statistical or econometric models

- At least 5 years of experience in validating statistical or econometric models

- At least 2 years of experience with data governance

- At least 2 years of experience with predictive analytics

jobs.title: Senior Finance Associate - Finance Transformation (12-month fixed-term contract)
jobs.description:
Nottingham Trent House (95002), United Kingdom, Nottingham, Nottinghamshire

Senior Finance Associate - Finance Transformation (12-month fixed-term contract)

Job Title: Senior Finance Associate - Finance Transformation (12-month fixed-term contract)

Location: Nottingham - Hybrid

Working Pattern: 3 days in-office (Tuesday-Thursday) and 2 days remote.

Our Mission
We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role
We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. To support this, we are looking for a dynamic, self-motivated finance professional to join our UK Finance team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.
This is a specialised hybrid role that sits at the intersection of financial strategy and project delivery. As a dedicated Finance Transformation Lead, you aren't just supporting finance routines—you are driving the end-to-end technical execution of complex strategic initiatives. We are looking for an 'Insightful Investigator' who can translate between finance data and systems requirements to deliver solutions that scale.

What You’ll Do
- Project Leadership: Act as the lead resource for finance-based projects, navigating governance routines and managing RAIDD (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies, and Decisions) items.

- Rigorous Execution: Drive key project testing cycles, managing UAT and Close Simulation (SIM) test scenarios efficiently to strict deadlines.

- Proactive Problem Solving: Identify system blockers early (such as issues with financial dashboards and reports), develop workarounds, and clearly communicate the impact to other Lines of Business.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with UK and enterprise teams, to resolve issues and represent UK Finance's interests.

- Clear Communication: Focus and highlight key points with transparency when communicating complex project statuses to stakeholders.

- Data-Driven Insights: Go beyond surface-level analysis to generate meaningful insights, analysing qualitative and quantitative data to ensure data integrity.

- Core Finance Support: Provide general finance support and remediations as we balance priorities during this transition.

The Skills and Experience You’ll Need
- The Right Blend: Proven experience in traditional finance processes (forecasting, variance analysis) combined with a strong project management or systems implementation background.

- Systems Knowledge: Experience with general finance concepts, tools and financial systems is highly preferred, but a strong aptitude and adaptability to learn new systems are just as critical.

- Strategic Judgment: The ability to navigate difficult stakeholder situations and comprehensively consider the impact of decisions on other partner groups.

- Autonomous Execution: A proactive mindset to identify problems, drive independent solutions, and influence your team to shape better outcomes.

- Team-First Attitude: A collaborative approach, focused on building strong, connected working relationships, as this is how we get things done at Capital One.

- Innovation: A strong focus on driving process improvement and a willingness to embrace new technology and AI to unlock operational efficiencies.

- Systems Knowledge (Nice-to-Have): While broad systems experience is preferred, experience specifically with Workday Financials is a highly desirable asset.

Where and How You'll Work
This is a 12-month fixed-term position based in our Nottingham offices. While not guaranteed, there is potential to explore a permanent role at the end of the contract. We embrace a hybrid approach: you'll spend three days a week in our purpose-built office (featuring an on-site gym, restaurant, and Learning Loft), with the option to work from home on Mondays and Fridays.
What you should know about how we recruit
We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.
We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.
Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Principal Associate, Operational Risk Management, Third Party Risk Manager (TPRM)

Capital One is seeking an energetic, self-motivated Principal Associate to join the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) Team within the Operational Risk Management (ORM) second line of defense. The TPRM team is a dedicated group of professionals whose mission is to provide value-add, independent stewardship of Capital One's third-party management practices, enabling Capital One to manage its Third Party Risk effectively and resiliently.
The successful candidate will play a critical role in driving the strategy, integrity, and continuous improvement of the Third Party Risk Management Framework across the enterprise. In this role, you will lead high-impact governance programs, serve as a core subject matter expert, and ensure our risk management practices are rigorously executed and well-managed. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and leadership to navigate a dynamic regulatory landscape and uphold sound risk practices.
Responsibilities
- Support Framework and Policy Governance: Support the enterprise TPRM policies and standards across the full lifecycle.

- Drive Risk Oversight Programs: Lead the execution of the annual TPRM Risk Oversight Program Self-Assessment and Process Criticality Assessments to ensure robust framework compliance.

- Act as an Internal SME: Serve as the primary subject matter expert on TPRM requirement applicability, providing guidance to the business and participating in broader partner risk assessments (such as Cyber Program assessments) from a holistic risk perspective.

- Manage Issue Remediation: Own and lead the end-to-end remediation of TPRM-related risk issues, ensuring sustainable, well-managed solutions are implemented.

- Maintain Taxonomies and Diagnostics: Shape and maintain the TPRM Risk Taxonomies and Process Diagnostic guidance to ensure consistency and clarity across the enterprise.

- Support Audits and Exams: Act as a key partner and facilitator for relevant first-line and second-line audits, regulatory examinations, and Process Level Assessments.

- Ensure Mandate Compliance: Support Designated Mandate Owners (DMO) with rigorous requirement fulfillment and annual attestation processes.

- International TPRM Requirements: Serve as the primary point of contact and expert in the applicability of international TPRM requirements to the Capital One program.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree or military experience.

- At least 3 years of experience in Operational Risk Management, Third-Party Risk Management, Compliance, or Audit within a financial institution or a regulated industry.

- At least 2 years of experience in process management governance.

Preferred Qualifications
- 4+ years of experience in a dedicated Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) role focusing on overall risk framework, governance, and policy (as opposed to technical or cyber-only security assessments).

- 3+ years of experience in Process Management or Project Management, with a strong understanding of how to optimize risk workflows.

- Proven track record of leading risk remediation efforts and managing interactions with internal audit or regulatory examiners.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and synthesize complex risk concepts for leadership.

jobs.title: Vertical Risk Manager: Card Risk
jobs.description:
Vertical Risk Manager: Card Risk

We enable our Card business to innovate and deliver exceptional products and services in a well-managed risk ecosystem while ensuring we keep our promises to customers.  As a Vertical Risk Manager at Capital One you’ll be responsible for working with business partners to identify and mitigate potential risks to Capital One. Risk Managers at Capital One are the front line of defense to ensure our Company remains stable and profitable.

Risk Managers lead, advise and innovate on top transformational initiatives across the businesses in the first line of defense and are responsible for working with business partners to identify and mitigate potential risks to Capital One. You will collaborate with a team of risk managers responsible for working across the enterprise to develop and implement cutting edge risk solutions to ensure Capital One’s continued growth and success.

Risk Managers have a high level of exposure across lines of business and have the opportunity to partner with Executives and their teams to identify potential risks in an open, collaborative environment where new ideas and solutions are both welcomed and rewarded.

Responsibilities:
- Consult on risk to business partners providing advice and guidance as required

- Serve as a liaison, interfacing with business partners, Tech, and other assurance functions, such as legal, compliance to drive meaningful reductions in risk

- Effectively challenge business partners, 2nd line functions (ex: Compliance and Operational Risk Management ) and 3rd line (i.e., Audit/Credit Review)

- Lead/support regulatory exams and audits

- Synthesize data and reporting; perform analysis and bring valuable proactive business insights through evaluation of data provided by team analysts

- Drive and deliver results and improvements in line with the business’ well managed and risk agendas

- Stay current on the changing regulatory environment and understand the impacts to the businesses

- Collaborate effectively across multiple levels and organizations

- Collaborate effectively between risk, compliance and other business support functions (e.g., legal, privacy) (e.g., operations, risk management, enterprise management, etc.) to achieve objectives and support the organization in delivering on top priorities in a timely and efficient manner

- Lead or strategically advise on risk assessments

- Is a thought leader in providing guidance to businesses and supporting functions in implementing risk management practices

- Identify broader needs and lead problem solving using risk forums to influence change and continuous improvement of risk management practices

- Set direction, manages expectations and influence cross-functional teams

- Strong communication and collaboration skills

Here’s what we’re looking for in an ideal teammate:

- You are a critical thinker who seeks to understand the business, its processes and platforms, risks and control environment.

- You create energy and an environment that fosters trust, collaboration, and belonging.

- You possess a relentless focus on quality and timeliness.

- You adapt to change, embrace bold ideas, and are intellectually curious. You like to ask questions, test assumptions, and challenge conventional thinking.

- You develop influential relationships based upon shared risk objectives.

- You do the right thing and lead by example. You have a passion for coaching and investing in the betterment of the team.

Basic Qualifications:
- High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification
- At least 4 years of Compliance, Legal, Audit,  or first or second line Risk Management experience

- At least 3 years of Project or Process Management experience

- At least 3 years of experience supporting, partnering and interacting with internal business clients

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree

- 5+ years of Project Management experience leading cross functional projects and programs in Risk

- 5+ years of Compliance, Legal, Audit, or first or second line Risk Management experience

- 3+ years of experience in reporting and analyzing data

- Professional certifications within risk management and/or assurance: Certified Risk Management Professional, Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Risk Management Assurance (CRMA) or Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM)

- PMP, Lean, Agile or Six Sigma certification

jobs.description:
Recruiting: Mexico City, Mex, Mexico, Ciudad de Mexico, Ciudad de Mexico

Technology Development Program Associate - Mexico - 2027

Key Role Details
- Full-time new hires for this role will start as a cohort in a rotational program in August 2027.

- This role is a full-time associate position within a 18-month rotational program, designed as a career accelerator to foster the next generation of leading talent.

- Participation in the program requires that you are located in Mexico City, with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model . For those not currently located in Mexico City, it is expected that you will relocate prior to the start of the program in August 2027.

Basic Qualifications
- Intermediate-Advanced English fluency

- A completed Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, System Engineering, Information Technology, or other technical field obtained between December 2025 and August 2027, with an expectation that you will complete your most recent full-time degree program by August 2027.

Preferred Qualifications
- Strong analytical, quantitative, problem solving and conceptual skills

- Strong interpersonal, leadership and communication skills

- Intermediate to advanced programming skills or experience in one or more of the following areas: Go, Kotlin, Python, Java, HTML, Swift, XML, JSON, UML, JavaScript, SQL, PL/SQL, Shell scripts, Objective C, C#, C/C++, Perl, .net, asp.net, Visual Basic

- Hands on technical experience through activities such as: technical internship, part-time technical role, STEM teaching assistant, or technical research

- Experience leveraging interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion

Capital One, with the purpose to offer early career professionals an opportunity to support their experience and facilitate their professional growth, offers this position exclusively for university degree graduates in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, System Engineering, Information Technology, and related technical fields, who have completed their study program between December 2025 and August 2027.

Resumes Must Be Submitted in English

Technology Development Program Associate - Mexico - 2027

At Capital One, we consider ourselves the bank a technology company would build. We’re delivering best-in-class innovation so that our 65 million customers - and counting - can manage their finances with ease. Our reality and vision empower our engineers to use artificial intelligence and machine learning to transform real-time data, software, and algorithms into financial clarity. That’s what sets us apart - and we want you to join our journey.
We’re all-in on the cloud and are a leader in the adoption of open source, RESTful APIs, microservices, and containers. We build our own products and release them with a speed and agility that allows us to get new customer experiences to market quickly. We’re going boldly where no bank has gone before. And, as a founder-led company, we’re inspired to make, break, do, and do good. So, let’s do something great together. Want to learn more? Check out the low-down on our high-tech - https://www.capitalone.com/tech

Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who solve real problems and meet real customer needs.

As a Software Engineer in the Technology Development Program - Mexico, you may work on everything from customer-facing web and mobile applications using cutting-edge open source frameworks, to highly-available RESTful services, to back-end Java based systems using the hottest techniques in Big Data. Our engineers work in a “You Build It, You Own It" full stack environment supporting an exciting and innovative tech stack composed of: Java, React, Angular, Vue JS, C#, REST APIs, NoSQL database, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, Docker, AWS cloud, Scala, Clojure, Java, Haskell, C++, golang, Scheme, Common Lisp, AI-powered development tools for accelerating development and continuously improving code quality, and more!

You'll have the freedom to explore different roles, teams and technologies while zeroing in on the career that's right for you. Designed as a career accelerator to foster the next generation of leading talent, the Mexico-TDP provides you the framework to develop world-class technical skills and gain a comprehensive understanding of technology.

What to expect:
- A challenging role where you will work collaboratively on agile teams with talented colleagues who are ready to take on new and unexpected challenges while building the next wave of engineering solutions

- Current, state of the art technology and tools, including working with a cloud-native stack, building on AWS using technologies like Kubernetes and Serverless

- Experience working with cutting-edge AI coding tools to enhance productivity, accelerate development, and continuously improve code quality

- Technical mentorship and training through meetups, conferences, certifications and tech talks to build out your skillset on topics such iOS and Android, AWS, Open Source Big Data tools, Security, Voice Driven Applications and more

- Exposure to Technology executives and a diverse network of skilled engineers

- The opportunity to rotate roles and work with a variety of tools and technologies and to learn from different leaders throughout the Tech organization

- Fun social and volunteer events with other new hires

- Join our team and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes a generous pension plan, top-tier medical and life insurance, a discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), flexible days off, fertility benefits, and more to prioritize associates total wellbeing, for you and your family

Life at Capital One
Our associates flourish in our open culture where diversity of ideas and collective wisdom prevail. We proudly bring together associates with different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to challenge the status quo. We’re focused on helping associates live well—physically, financially and emotionally. When you join us, we support you and those who are most important to you, offering full coverage for spouses, domestic partners, and dependents. We’ve designed our benefits program to be flexible, comprehensive and consistent across our organization. From training and professional development programs—and much more—you’ll discover that Capital One is committed to helping you live your best life.

Continuous Learning:
We’re here to help you gain knowledge both on the job and in the classroom. Our engineers have access to continuous learning through our very own Tech College, a world-class learning hub that offers both online and in-person classes across 7 disciplines—Agile, Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, Data, Machine Learning & AI, Mobile and Software Engineering.

Do you like working in the spotlight? Are you ready to work on the front line of a top 10 Bank and growing payments network? Can you build relationships as well as develop and implement innovative solutions? As a Senior Risk Associate at Capital One you’ll be responsible for working with business partners to identify and mitigate potential risks to Capital One. Senior Risk Associates at Capital One are the front line of defense to ensure our Company remains stable and profitable.

Senior Risk Associates at Capital One are highly motivated Risk Management professionals with excellent organizational and communication skills. They have a high level of exposure across lines of business and have the opportunity to create and implement innovative solutions to identify and mitigate potential risks to the Company.

The Issues and Events Program team supports the Global Payments Network Risk and Advisory organization. jobs.description:
Senior Risk Associate - Risk, Infrastructure, and Governance

Commercial Risk is a first line of defense function which supports our Commercial Banking Lines of Business in managing non-credit risk. Commercial Risk associates collaborate across the division, as well as with other Line of Business first line teams and second and third line partners, to develop and implement well-managed risk practices.

As a Sr. Risk Associate on the Risk Infrastructure and Governance team, the ideal candidate will have excellent written & verbal communication, strong interpersonal skills, the ability to work autonomously, flexibility in managing changing priorities in an Agile framework, and a desire to help the Commercial Bank succeed.

Strong problem solving, integrative thinking, prioritization, and analytical skills are essential for success in this role. Additionally, building win-win partnerships with multiple business stakeholders and across Commercial Risk work streams while adapting to change in a dynamic environment are key for this role.

Responsibilities:
- Leading the Commercial Bank Policy Office: writing, updating, and socializing relevant policies, standards, and procedures.

- Provide support for Regulatory Change Management: assisting in the research, analysis, and documentation of the impacts of new or changed Federal and State laws, rules, regulations, and resulting legal requirements to Commercial Bank products and services.

- Assist Commercial Bank Cross Border Banking program: assessing the risks associated with foreign borrowers and regulatory requirements.

- Assist International Risk: Country Risk Assessments and drafting Country Exit Plans for in-scope countries for the Commercial Bank.

- Strategic Reporting: Provide comprehensive support for reporting routines, ensuring metrics are accurate and actionable for senior executive stakeholders.

- Drive Operational Excellence: Lead daily task execution across the team’s full scope, ensuring consistent delivery against project milestones and operational requirements.

- Operational Continuity: Serve as the primary coverage resource for key team functions during periods of transition or leave, minimizing disruptions to critical workstreams.

- Horizontal Engagement Model: Develop and document a horizontal engagement model to clarify roles, interactions, and responsibilities across team functions, moving from reactive to proactive program management.

- Collaborating with partners within Commercial Risk, Compliance, Legal, and various groups across the organization.

- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

- At least 2 years of Financial Services or Risk Management experience

- Commercial Bank experience

Sr. Manager, Compensation Strategy & Analytics

Are you interested in joining a team of Total Rewards leaders who enable game-changing business results by providing programs and strategies that unleash greatness in our associates? Here at Capital One, we bring a data-driven approach to compensation problem solving. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas, and backgrounds come together to make Capital One a great place to work.

Capital One is looking for a Sr. Manager, Compensation Strategy & Analytics to join our team. We are seeking proven leadership candidates who will engage in impactful work for the Enterprise, bringing a mix of strategy, research, analysis, and storytelling to shape our Enterprise compensation design. Principal Associate, Learning Program Manager

At Capital One, you'll notice a unique culture of enthusiasm, collaboration, innovation and agile creation happening on a routine basis. We have people leaders who believe we are humans first and support living your best life while achieving amazing things at work. As part of the Learning & Development team you will work closely with business leaders and HR staff to consult, design, develop, deliver, manage and analyze learning experiences for associates. You will play a critical role in making sure our learning experiences are designed with user and business objectives in mind. We hope this sounds like your dream team; it’s ours, and we worked hard to create and maintain it. We are looking to add a talented individual to our team to help us manage our growing portfolio of learning programs and events!

In this role you will create and communicate the product vision for the learning technology you own. You will be responsible for working from the customer backwards to make sure the product provides the optimal user experience. You will partner with vendors, HR Tech, business leaders, and learning stakeholders from across the organization to manage the product backlog and feature requests. In addition, the Associate who fills this role should have a focus on delivering efficient, reliable, resilient, scalable, and high performing solutions.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with internal partners across Capital One’s lines of business and within HR to support meeting the organization's development needs.
- Work on individual and team projects, own and solve problems, and partner to design and implement new processes
- Measure impact. You will identify the meaningful measurement for the product, track and iterate accordingly sharing with stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Risk Management - International and Access Risk
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Risk Management - International and Access Risk

As a Sr. Manager, International and Access Risk in the Financial Services Risk Office, you will provide professional risk judgment that enables both international business partners to tackle major company challenges and also enables access risk (user and system) processes and programs to lessen access related exposure. In this role, not only will you heavily lean into your analytical and problem solving skills by developing and deploying innovative solutions to mitigate risks to the Company, but you will also grow your strategic and influencing skills as you create and implement risk strategies across two domains (international and access) and multiple stakeholder groups. You will help create order and sense out of complexity and enable confident, data-inspired decision making.

In this role, you will thrive in a cross-functional and collaborative environment that values unique perspectives, rewards innovation, and challenges the status quo. As an integral member of the team, you will have a high level of exposure across the division and partner closely with senior business and risk office leaders across the enterprise, international business leaders across divisions and business entities, technology, compliance, legal, and operational risk.

Summary:
- Applies expertise on international risk best practices to assess current state, identify gaps, and assess international risk, threats, and business impact to the division and in scope jurisdictions
- Defines mitigation strategies, prioritizes and escalates recommendations in collaboration with multiple stakeholder and risk partner teams
- Defines and drive access risk reduction efforts for the division and participates in design and influencing of access control programs across the enterprise
- International or cross border business area-specific SME [knowledge of risk frameworks, information security risk assessments, information risk controls, regulatory and internal governance], data analysis [metrics and reporting], and customer engagement.

Responsibilities:
- Lead and orchestrate international risk and governance reporting for India-based operations and other jurisdictions where Financial Services maintains operations.
- Ensure international requirements and processes are seamlessly integrated across Financial Services risk assessments and interactions.
- Develop and maintain an access risk reduction strategy and execute against it with your team to drive-down access risk for the division.
- Partner and collaborate effectively with multiple risk and business stakeholder teams to achieve objectives and seamlessly coordinate and drive alignment across globally distributed business and risk teams.
- Execute various international oversight and governance activities for the division, including the facilitation of country entrance and exits, in line with business strategy.
- Understand emerging risks in both international and access domains, as well as within Capital One, ensuring division is appropriately prepared to respond
- Act as a key thought partner on evolving international risk priorities and access risk mitigation strategies
- Drive scalability and optimize resource allocation by aligning strategies with industry best practices and enterprise processes.
- Coordinate program-related activities and deliverables to ensure effective collaboration within the team and across stakeholder groups.
- Articulate complex technical concepts in a clear, concise, and actionable manner through both written products and verbal communications
- Oversee data-driven, risk-based analysis, starting with problem identification or hypothesis development

This role collaborates with resources based in India and would be expected to shift hours to start earlier than typical US business hours (e.g., 6am to 7am) to accommodate meetings and ensure availability with international groups. Role may also include international travel periodically in a year.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
- At least 7 years of experience in risk management, compliance, international risk operations, or access management
- At least 3 years of financial services industry experience or experience working in a regulatory environment
- At least 3 years of experience in people management
- At least 3 years of experience consulting with and presenting to senior executive leadership

Preferred Qualifications:
- Masters Degree or MBA
- 8+ years of experience in international risk management
- 8+ years of experience leading cross-functional projects and programs within a risk management organization

jobs.title: Manager, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
Manager, Enterprise Risk Management

Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. Our goal is to create one of the nation’s great banks, and we have the necessary ingredients: a strong balance sheet, resilient businesses, a massive customer franchise, strong analytical capabilities, and great people. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.

Capital One’s Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) organization has responsibility for helping the overall organization identify, manage, and mitigate key risks that may keep the company from achieving its strategic objectives. We are currently seeking a Manager to join the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) organization to support the execution, maintenance, and enhancement of the Company’s Risk Appetite Framework, including process execution, risk metrics strategy, and technology enablement. The Manager will have the opportunity to apply risk management and analytical skills to some of our highest profile Risk Management projects, including implementing solutions to ensure Capital One’s continued stability and success. This includes bringing unique perspectives and experiences to help us be rigorous, curious, and creative, as well as enabling our organizations to maintain a sustainable and holistic risk profile in order to deliver superior products while also protecting our customers.

Additionally, this role is expected to provide oversight and effective challenge across all risk categories (e.g. financial and non-financial risk) and assist in developing key governance analysis and reporting for Senior Management and the executive risk committees / Board of Directors.

This manager must possess strong problem solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, process or project management capability, and results driven competencies are essential to succeeding in this role. This individual should feel comfortable working with quantitative and qualitative information and can move from the “gray” area to grounded recommendation in an organized and transparent manner.

Specific responsibilities include:
- Support the execution and day-to-day operations of the enterprise Risk Appetite Framework and risk metric programs
- Drive the project management and milestone execution for the risk metrics system of record initiative and other strategic team projects
- Execute and enhance Risk Appetite and risk metric strategies, methodologies, governance, and reporting elements
- Cultivate data sources to feed metrics/reporting; clearly define requirements for creation and ongoing enhancements of an enterprise risk metric system of record
- Perform and support detailed validation data analysis to include trending, problem identification, and development/completion of remediation plans
- Consult on analysis and reporting outcomes to observe trends and provide insights on changes to the Company’s risk environments
- Collaborate effectively with stakeholders and leaders across multiple organizations to achieve objectives
- Demonstrate problem-solving and analysis skills with attention to detail
- Demonstrate strong communication, collaboration, problem solving and influencing skills across various levels of the organization
- Actively support internal control testing, audits, and regulatory exams
- Stay abreast of the changing regulatory environment and understand the impacts to Capital One
- Balance multiple priorities to help drive business value and support team objectives, while managing tasks and activities related to risk management initiatives in a well-managed capacity

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
- At least 4 years of experience in Project or Process Management
- At least 4 years of Financial Services or Risk Management experience
- At least 4 years of experience in metric analysis or governance reporting

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s Degree
- 5+ years of experience in project, process, or framework management
- 5+ years of Financial Services risk management experience
- 2+ years of internal strategy or management consulting experience

jobs.title: Business Strategy Manager - Network Policy & Rules Advisory
jobs.description:
Business Strategy Manager - Network Policy & Rules Advisory

The Business Strategy Manager will serve as a subject matter expert leading the architecture and advisory function for Global Payment Network rules, technical specifications, and network policies. In this role, you will provide deep payment network expertise, conduct industry and competitive analysis, and offer effective challenge to ensure network governance remains current, consistent, and aligned with industry standards.

While you will partner closely with platform build and project management leads supporting the consolidation and re-architecture of Discover’s Operating Regulations, your primary focus is advising on payment network rules, navigating complex compliance requirements, and shaping strategic rule governance across major payment brands.

Core Responsibilities:
- Advisory & Effective Challenge: Provide independent review, competitive analysis, and effective challenge to proposed rule changes, product initiatives, and network strategies to ensure clarity, durability, and alignment with industry best practices.
- Architecture & Solution Design: Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and unintended consequences in proposed network rules and technical specifications; recommend pragmatic, durable solutions to shape network policy architecture.
- Industry & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct continuous competitive analysis and industry research across card networks, real-time payment systems, processors, and issuers to keep network policies cutting-edge.
- Framework Modernization: Serve as the core policy advisor supporting the modernization and simplification of the Global Payment Network rules framework and the rollout of an Enterprise Operating Rules Management and Publishing Platform.
- Waiver & Policy Governance: Oversee and evaluate Operating Regulation waiver requests, establishing operational frameworks and standardized review processes.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build and maintain strong working relationships across Legal, Risk, Product, Technology, and Operations, translating complex policy and technical specs into clear reports and executive presentations.
- Governance Compliance: Ensure advisory activities comply with Capital One’s project and program management standards (Enterprise Programs Standard, Enterprise Programs Procedure, and the EWI/DLI Playbook).
- Process & Technology Innovation: Leverage advanced problem-solving skills, operational KPIs, and technology (including AI-enabled tools) to enhance rule quality and consistency while retaining strict human accountability.

Basic Qualifications:
- High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification
- At least 4 years of experience advising on Payment Network Rules and Regulations
- At least 5 years of experience in policy design, contract interpretation and rule-based governance models

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree
- 3+ years of experience in team leadership or direct people management
- Prior experience with card networks, real-time payment networks, card payment acquirers, payment processors or card issuers
- Experience in industry research, competitive analysis and policy architecture for large-scale payment ecosystems

Senior Manager, Category Management

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a Senior Manager, Category Management to join our Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team. In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver superior experiences for both internal and external clients.

As a Senior Manager, Category Management you will be responsible for the holistic relationship between Capital One and key third parties, enabling a well-managed and adaptable supply chain. You will apply your strategic and analytical skills to create and strengthen relationships with industry leading companies in the automotive space, specifically related to sales, marketing and financial services businesses. You will work closely with internal team members establishing and maintaining relationships with internal business customers, account teams and assigned suppliers. This role is essential in the delivery of key cost, risk, and performance management-related efforts for third-party relationships, in addition to identifying strategic opportunities for growth and/or greater return on investment.

If you enjoy connecting with others, collaborating on cross-functional teams and negotiating deals, we are looking for YOU. Come be a part of something special where you work with teams who appreciate your contributions and your thoughts and ideas are encouraged.

Key responsibilities include:
- Negotiation : Partner to negotiate contracts and deals for a fast paced, motivated business group within Capital One
- Problem Solving & Strategy Advice : Provide problem-solving and innovative ideas to support internal customers. Identify value-generating opportunities (e.g. savings, efficiencies, or revenue growth).
- Relationship Management : Serve as a primary point of contact for third parties and manage an effective governance between Capital One and assigned third parties.
- Collaboration : Build strong internal relationships with key stakeholders that creates alignment on business strategy and fosters ability to move quickly on desired business outcomes in a well managed way.
- Risk Management: Monitor and ensure successful delivery against third party contractual obligations.  Partner with internal risk groups to ensure third party relationships are compliant with all relevant policies and procedures.
- Process Management : Accountable for policy requirements for all managed third-party relationships. Plan and lead periodic reviews and assessments of supplier relationships.
- Supplier Sourcing : Maintain awareness of the external marketplace as it relates to your suppliers and perform sourcing activities where appropriate.
- People Management : Serving as a people manager, coach and mentor to develop less seasoned and experienced Supplier Managers in their development.
- Partnership : Evaluate industry trends, technological shifts and market dynamics to identify and engage the right partners to advance the development of Capital One projects, programs and products that positively impact the customer experience
- Executive communication : Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills.

Sr Manager, HR Risk Management

Human Resources Senior Risk Manager

Are you interested in joining a team of best-in-class HR leaders who enable game-changing business results by providing programs and solutions that unleash greatness in our associates?

At Capital One, you have the opportunity to work in an environment in which the business truly values strategic HR partnership and results. If you have a passion for shaping the overall people strategy for a business and want to be part of a winning team, then look no further! We work in a business-casual, collaborative environment where one’s contributions are recognized, successes are elevated, and effort is rewarded.

The HR Senior Risk Manager will play a key role in supporting the HR Risk Management Framework within Capital One’s international operations, providing day-to-day risk and control advisory for HR functions in Mexico and across global expansion initiatives.

This role ensures that HR processes, controls, and risk management activities are designed, documented, and operating effectively in alignment with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) standards, local labor and privacy regulations, and HR operational requirements.

The position will work closely with HR functional teams, Legal, Compliance, and other Risk functions, as well as with the Mexico HR Leadership team, to maintain a strong control environment, enhance HR governance, and drive continuous improvement in risk and compliance processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Risk Management & Governance -

- Implement and maintain the HR Risk Management Framework for Mexico and international HR operations, ensuring alignment with ERM and Compliance standards.

- Maintain accurate risk aggregation and reporting, partnering with global HR Risk teams to ensure visibility of emerging risks and mitigation activities.

- Lead and coordinate the issue and event management process for HR Mexico, ensuring timely identification, escalation, remediation, and closure within agreed timelines.

- Partner with other Risk functions, Compliance, and Legal to ensure regulatory applicability and adherence across HR operations, including data privacy and workforce regulations.

Controls, Audits, Exams & Regulatory Compliance

- Design, document, and execute HR Process controls in accordance with Capital One’s ERM standards and local requirements.

- Support internal and external audits, and exams, ensuring all control evidence and documentation are accurate, up to date, and aligned with corporate policies.

- Partner with Legal and Compliance to assess the impact of regulatory changes, translating them into HR operational requirements and control enhancements.

Process Management & Continuous Improvement

- Lead and document business process mapping for HR activities, identifying risks, dependencies, and control points throughout the associate lifecycle.

- Collaborate with HR functional leaders to ensure processes are standardized, efficient, and compliant, incorporating risk considerations into design and execution.

- Maintain accurate and updated program documentation, including process maps, SOPs, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs).

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Serve as HR Risk point of contact for Mexico HR leadership and a liaison with the Global HR Risk, Legal, Compliance and ORM teams.

- Partner with HR stakeholders to strengthen awareness of risk management practices, control testing, and documentation discipline.

- Contribute to HR Risk reporting and participation in global forums and initiatives, ensuring consistency of risk communication across regions.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree

- At least 5 years of experience in Risk Management, Compliance, or Internal Controls functions.

- At least 5 years of experience in business process management or continuous improvement, preferably within HR or shared services.

- Intermediate - advanced English fluency

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Financial Services or Regulated Industries.

- Experience supporting global or multi-country HR functions.

- Knowledge of local regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements

- Understanding of ERM frameworks, audit processes, and HR compliance requirements (employment law, privacy, third-party risk).

- PMP, Lean, or Six Sigma certification

Senior Risk Associate- Global Payments Network

As a Senior Analyst in Network Credit Settlement Risk, within the Global Payment Network division, you will apply your financial, quantitative, and risk assessment skills to safeguard Capital One’s balance sheet against complex counterparty exposures. You will team with a diverse team of Risk Professionals, Relationship Managers, Legal, and Operations teams to evaluate and manage risk for the Global Payment Network. And you will do it all in a collaborative, fast-paced environment that values your analytical rigor, encourages decision-making independence, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovative risk-mitigation strategies.

General Responsibilities:

- Analysis & Credit Assessment: Perform comprehensive financial and credit risk assessments for new and existing counterparties to formulate internal risk ratings and risk mitigation strategies.
- Exposure Management: Monitor and evaluate daily, intraday, and settlement exposures driven by card network settlement cycles.
- Risk Mitigation & Structuring: Design, negotiate, and manage dynamic risk-mitigation structures, including prefunding levels, reserves, Standby Letters of Credit, and parental guarantees to optimize client liquidity while protecting bank capital.
- Surveillance & Portfolio Monitoring: Maintain continuous risk surveillance across the counterparty portfolio to detect Early Warning Indicators, track compliance covenants, and manage reporting waivers.
- Execution & Governance: Lead end-to-end credit review workflows, frame analytical hypotheses, scope operational feasibility for risk controls, and present clear risk recommendations to senior credit committees and regulatory examiners.
- Partnership: Work closely with cross-functional colleagues across Capital One, including Relationship Managers, Product, Data, Operations, Legal, and Finance, to align risk appetite with commercial growth, volume acquisition, and institutional profitability.

Basic Qualifications (BQs):

- Bachelor's Degree or Military experience
- At least 3 years of professional experience performing counterparty credit risk analysis, commercial credit underwriting, or financial institution analysis.

Preferred Qualifications (PQs):

- At least 4 years of experience evaluating global payment clearing mechanics, merchant acquiring risk, or settlement float dynamics.
- At least 4 years of experience with risk management platforms and credit databases such as Bloomberg, Capital IQ, or Credit Risk Monitor.
- At least 4 years of experience in business analysis or commercial credit underwriting within a large financial institution.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Associate-Global Payments Network
jobs.description:
Senior Risk Associate-Global Payments Network

As a Senior Analyst in Network Credit Settlement Risk, within the Global Payment Network division, you will apply your financial, quantitative, and risk assessment skills to safeguard Capital One’s balance sheet against complex counterparty exposures. You will team with a diverse team of Risk Professionals, Relationship Managers, Legal, and Operations teams to evaluate and manage risk for the Global Payment Network. And you will do it all in a collaborative, fast-paced environment that values your analytical rigor, encourages decision-making independence, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovative risk-mitigation strategies.

General Responsibilities:

- Analysis & Credit Assessment: Perform comprehensive financial and credit risk assessments for new and existing counterparties to formulate internal risk ratings and risk mitigation strategies.
- Exposure Management: Monitor and evaluate daily, intraday, and settlement exposures driven by card network settlement cycles.
- Risk Mitigation & Structuring: Design, negotiate, and manage dynamic risk-mitigation structures, including prefunding levels, reserves, Standby Letters of Credit, and parental guarantees to optimize client liquidity while protecting bank capital.
- Surveillance & Portfolio Monitoring: Maintain continuous risk surveillance across the counterparty portfolio to detect Early Warning Indicators, track compliance covenants, and manage reporting waivers.
- Execution & Governance: Lead end-to-end credit review workflows, frame analytical hypotheses, scope operational feasibility for risk controls, and present clear risk recommendations to senior credit committees and regulatory examiners.
- Partnership: Work closely with cross-functional colleagues across Capital One, including Relationship Managers, Product, Data, Operations, Legal, and Finance, to align risk appetite with commercial growth, volume acquisition, and institutional profitability.

Basic Qualifications (BQs):

- Bachelor's Degree or Military experience
- At least 3 years of professional experience performing counterparty credit risk analysis, commercial credit underwriting, or financial institution analysis.

Preferred Qualifications (PQs):

- At least 4 years of experience evaluating global payment clearing mechanics, merchant acquiring risk, or settlement float dynamics.
- At least 4 years of experience with risk management platforms and credit databases such as Bloomberg, Capital IQ, or CreditRiskMonitor.
- At least 4 years of experience in business analysis or commercial credit underwriting within a large financial institution.
- At least 4 years of experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning tools, predictive analytics, or automation frameworks (such as Python, natural language processing pipelines, or Generative AI credit analysis tools) to financial statement spreading, risk modeling, or portfolio surveillance.
- Experience drafting executive-level credit memos and communicating financial analysis to senior management and internal stakeholders.

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

jobs.description:
Principal Risk Associate

Level: Principal Associate
Location: McLean or Richmond - VA and Hybrid

About Business Cards & Payments (BC&P) | Build the Future.
At BC&P, we bring a builder's mindset to work, just like the business owners we serve. Small businesses are a different kind of customer. They're the people turning ideas into opportunities, and opportunities into livelihoods. When we build for them, we build something bigger. That's why we have a high bar for quality. We own the work end to end, turning today's insights into tomorrow's results, together.
- We're relentlessly curious.

- We ask the hard questions.

- We make space for the best ideas to win.

Because that's how we create impact we can be proud of.

The Team:
In Business Cards and Payments (BC&P), we are on a mission to pave the path for businesses to do more business. Within the BC&P Operating Office , we serve as the operational engine, enabling alignment, velocity, and resilience across the organization. Our office is comprised of three pillars - Strategic, Organizational, and Top of House Operations - that collectively drive our commitment to operational excellence. We are seeking a forward-thinking Principal Risk Associate to help advance our BC&P operational strategy.
You will help lead automation, artificial intelligence, and innovative ways to elevate the maturity of our operational processes along with ensuring proper regulatory compliance. By partnering with stakeholders to implement scalable, technology-forward solutions, you will drive adherence to well managed practices while identifying and operationalizing process improvements.

The Role:
The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented professional with a passion for innovation, improvements, and compliance. You thrive on staying ahead of the curve, utilizing the latest industry trends and technological advancements to optimize internal processes. As a collaborative influencer, you excel at building strong relationships across cross-functional teams, championing process efficiency, and actively contributing to the maturity of our process and control ecosystem. You are a self-starter who works autonomously, managing multiple priorities and initiatives with minimal supervision.

Joining our team means operating at the intersection o f risk management and modern technology. We are looking for a thinker who not only understands risk but actively seeks ways to simplify and modernize how we manage it. If you enjoy navigating dynamic environments, influencing change through data-driven insights, and driving efficiency, this role provides the platform to make a meaningful impact.

Job Responsibilities:
- Regulatory Oversight: Working with the business to ensure proper implementation of processes/programs to be compliant with new regulatory laws like Dodd-Frank Section 1071.

- GenAI Governance: Partner with GenAI Director to ensure a well managed approach for GenAI across BC&P pre and post implementation.

- LAUNCH Initiative : Partnering with key stakeholders to ensure the LAUNCH is efficient for BC&P by monitoring and managing the implementation of the change initiative, track progress, adjust as needed.

Basic Qualifications :
- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

- At least 4 years of experience in Risk Management, Project Management, Process Management, Compliance, or Audit

- At least 3 years of experience working with business and risk teams to drive cross-functional operational initiatives

Preferred Qualifications :
- 5+ years of experience in Risk Management, Project Management, Process Management, Compliance, or Audit

- Proven track record of transforming operational workflows and enhancing process maturity through the implementation of automation, data-driven insights, and technology-led solutions

- Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguous environments and manage multiple priorities autonomously

- Experience leveraging automation tools such as: GenAI, workflow automation, or data visualization to transform operational workflows

jobs.title: Sr. Risk Associate, Commercial Bank
jobs.description:
Sr. Risk Associate, Commercial Bank

Job Description :
Are you ready to work for a top 10 bank? At Capital One, we nurture an environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds come together to solve complex problems. The ideal candidate brings an entrepreneurial spirit and a drive to “get to the right place”.

Within the Commercial Bank Risk Office, you will be challenged to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor compliance and operational controls. As a member of the Controls Team, the Sr. Risk Associate will be responsible for working with designated Commercial Bank business teams to uncover opportunities to strengthen the control environment and reduce risks for the business while building lasting partnerships. The role provides opportunities for thought-leadership and senior leadership exposure in a dynamic and changing business.

Success in this position will rely on working with cross-functional teams, identifying strategies to build and improve control processes and analyzing data. The candidate should be well-versed in compliance and operational risk management frameworks.

Responsibilities :
- Strong Written & Oral Communication - ability to clearly and concisely explain complex risk concepts, coupled with influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement across the lines of defense
- Clear Results Orientation - display a focus on achieving both short and long term goals and continuously pursue best possible results.
- Ability to drive and execute an agenda in a fluid environment.
- Ensure controls monitoring and deliverables are completed per guidelines. Reviews work products with attention to detail ensuring accuracy, quality and overall value
- Highly motivated and self-directed with a strong sense of ownership
- Analytical and operational knowledge to design, develop and implement compliance and controls monitoring strategies
- Skilled in risk assessment, familiarity with control testing, regulatory testing and financial control testing
- Strategic & Analytic Orientation - proven track record of decision making and problem solving. Able to effectively design, implement, and monitor compliance and operational controls.
- Conceptual Thinking - strong critical thinking as a large part of the role is based on operational risk management
- Judgment & Integrity - tenacious decision maker, able to bring a sound approach to controls management. Drive sustainable corrective actions by connecting control results to inherent risks.

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

Basic Qualifications :
- Bachelor's Degree or Military experience
- At least 2 years of Financial Services or Risk Management experience

Preferred Qualifications :
- At least 3 years of Audit, Compliance, or Operational Risk Management experience
- At least 3 years of quality assurance or quality assurance testing experience
- Process improvement experience
- Highly proficient in creating and maintaining information in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, and Word) or Google Suite (Slides, Sheets, and Docs)
- Risk Management Certification
